body:

It's insane that it's even close right now. After all, Tim Walz and the Democrats have completely failed Minnesota and attacked our God-given rights. The problem is, you and I know that and remember it everyday, but the typical voter is different. Voters have short term memories and it's our job to inform them and educate them on Walz and his comrades' records. Like how Politicians **Julie Sandstede and Dave Lislegard CONNED their voters** into making them believe they stood with small businesses in 2020, only to FLIP FLOP in 2021 and vote to protect Tim Walz' Emergency Powers. **It's because of Sandstede and Liselgard that Tim Walz' illegal shutdowns were able to continue.** And the damage of the COVID Scam against us isn't over. Now were' on the cusp of Democrats forcing our children to get the experimental jab in order to attend school. **THIS IS THE LINE WE DON'T CROSS!** Nothing motivates me more than bad politicians targeting my children. I'm sure you feel the same way. When the CDC story broke the news the other week about approving the experimental COVID shot on the immunization schedule, we sprung into action. I'm happy to let you know that we just sent out a MASSIVE STATEWIDE MAILER to parents informing them that Walz and Democrats are trying to force the experimental jab on their little children. Democrats are hell bent on continuing to get us all to take the experimental jab. And they won't stop until we all roll up the sleeve...even our kids. **I don't want to stop with just the mailer. We're running digital ads and a gigantic texting program targeting voters with children around the state.** We're already lining up our legislative program to fight this in January as well.
## [**I need YOUR IMMEDIATE HELP!!!**](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=it_all_comes_down_to_this&n=3)
Please reach deep into your pockets and donate to help us scare these politicians from EVER thinking they can force these vaccines on our children! Because of you helping us fund our extensive door knocking and phone calling operations last year, we were able to force politicians to End Walz' Emergency Powers. We created political heat for politicians like Julie Sandstede and Dave Lislegard. And that's how we win in politics. Our tactics work. Politicians who go against our liberties, pay the political price. But I'm useless without an army of supporters behind me. **So please help me. NOW IS THE TIME to STOP the vaccine mandates on our children in its tracks!!! Please make a donation of $25, $50, $100, $250 or more IMMEDIATELY.** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=it_all_comes_down_to_this&n=4 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=it_all_comes_down_to_this&n=4)

Hi Peter,

Earlier this year I was given one of the most important jobs I'll ever have: being a grandmother.

We welcomed a beautiful baby girl into our family, and I couldn't be happier. And as much as I would love more time with my granddaughter, I think part of being a good grandma is being out here on the campaign trail, fighting for her future.

I want her to have every possible opportunity for a great life here in Oklahoma. And yet, I worry that she's growing up in a state where, as a woman, she's going to face big challenges.

This year the Norman Transcript reported on a national study showing that "Oklahoma is considered the worst state to live in for women." And while I hate hearing something like that about my home state, there are hard truths there that we shouldn't ignore.

In the study Oklahoma got bottom-of-the-barrel rankings on "Women's Economic and Social Well Being" and "Women's Health Care and Safety." We are "43rd in share of women in poverty... 50th in the female uninsured rate, 46th in women’s life expectancy at birth and 47th in women’s preventative health care."

Those statistics are alarming, but the real effect of those numbers have tragic impacts. For example, our maternal mortality rate, which is among the worst in the nation. Right now, too many women are dying in childbirth in our state -- and too many babies are starting life without mothers.

And that study came out _before_ Governor Stitt signed extreme laws that are an assault on women and doctors, and that show no mercy for victims of rape or incest, or for families forced to make agonizing spiritual and medical decisions. Thanks to Governor Stitt, we now live in a state where miscarriage bounty-hunters could swipe an Oklahoma woman's private health information for a $10,000 reward.

[**We have to do better. And we can if we elect leaders who will work to make women's (and everyone's) lives better by finding real solutions for education, health care, and economic opportunity. This state has given me tremendous opportunities, both as a business owner and a public servant. But for far too many women here, the path to health and financial security are a steeper climb than they need to be.

Take something like equal pay. Women still earn lower wages for equal work. And that doesn't just affect women. It harms whole families.

People were already struggling to afford healthcare, childcare, and housing -- and now prices on everyday essentials are surging. The pay gap means that working women and their families are finding it even harder to make ends meet.

There are solutions to these problems. But they're going to require real leadership -- and not political extremism and chaos that limit women's choices rather than ensuring opportunities for health and prosperity.

And as much as I would love more time with my granddaughter, I think part of being a good grandma is being out here on the campaign trail, fighting for her future. I want her to have every possible opportunity for a great life here in Oklahoma. And yet, I worry that she's growing up in a state where, as a woman, she's going to face big challenges. This year the Norman Transcript reported on a national study showing that "Oklahoma is considered the worst state to live in for women." And while I hate hearing something like that about my home state, there are hard truths there that we shouldn't ignore. In the study Oklahoma got bottom-of-the-barrel rankings on "Women's Economic and Social Well Being" and "Women's Health Care and Safety." We are "43rd in share of women in poverty... 50th in the female uninsured rate, 46th in women’s life expectancy at birth and 47th in women’s preventative health care." Those statistics are alarming, but the real effect of those numbers have tragic impacts. For example, our maternal mortality rate, which is among the worst in the nation. Right now, too many women are dying in childbirth in our state -- and too many babies are starting life without mothers. And that study came out before Governor Stitt signed extreme laws that are an assault on women and doctors, and that show no mercy for victims of rape or incest, or for families forced to make agonizing spiritual and medical decisions. Thanks to Governor Stitt, we now live in a state where miscarriage bounty-hunters could swipe an Oklahoma woman's private health information for a $10,000 reward. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = This state has given me tremendous opportunities, both as a business owner and a public servant. But for far too many women here, the path to health and financial security are a steeper climb than they need to be. Take something like equal pay. Women still earn lower wages for equal work. And that doesn't just affect women. It harms whole families. People were already struggling to afford healthcare, childcare, and housing -- and now prices on everyday essentials are surging. The pay gap means that working women and their families are finding it even harder to make ends meet. There are solutions to these problems. But they're going to require real leadership -- and not political extremism and chaos that limit women's choices rather than ensuring opportunities for health and prosperity. = We don't have to settle for less in Oklahoma. There are so many talented, strong women across this state who have so much to offer. I'm going to do everything I can to make sure that they -- and my new granddaughter -- have every chance to fulfill their promise here. The American people know the truth. The left has been lying to us day in and day out, and we will not stand for it. Our economy is tanking, family values are under attack, our border is wide open, and our freedom is at stake. subject: Phil Knight is trying to buy Oregon's election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek
body:
|
#
---
Peter — **In September, Republican billionaire Phil Knight contributed _$2 million_ to conservative Betsy Johnson's campaign.** Since Oregon started electronically recording donations, this is the single largest contribution by an individual to a campaign in the state... ever. Then last month, **Knight contributed another _$1.5 million_ — this time to MAGA Republican Christine Drazan's campaign. And that's on top of millions more he's spending to bankroll a red wave in local races across Oregon.** Think about that. Team:

It's always good to have a solid wingman on your six. So when President Obama came to Phoenix to help us turn out some voters last night, I was happy to see him.

He knows a thing or two about tough elections, and he came because he sees the same data we do. The same polls, the same turnout numbers.

**He came because he knows this is going to come down to the wire.** It's extremely likely that this race will be the closest in the country. But if we can get the people we need to vote early or on Election Day, we can do it. We can win.

And to reach all those people, we've got to fully fund our turnout program. We're spending down to zero almost every day now, but we're doing it because we know folks like you will help us get where we need to be the next day. So far, that's been true. But if we don't, if the floor falls out, we might lose. It's as simple as that. [Don't let that happen. Split a $10 donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project today, right now, and we'll put it to work immediately.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/32444?t=8&akid=5208%2E878179%2EYV9Qi7) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Mark Kelly and Voter Protection Project will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/32445?t=9&akid=5208%2E878179%2EYV9Qi7)

Thank you so, so much.

Friend, only in America could our family have achieved this level of opportunity. I'm the Black daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the 1960s South, and I have a real chance at becoming Florida’s next senator. I owe a large part of my success to Jerry, who has been my partner in crime fighting for more than three decades – but I also owe immense gratitude to grassroots supporters like you. Thanks to this massive grassroots team, we've been able to outraise Rubio every single quarter and make this race competitive . But we're in danger of falling short of our midnight fundraising goal – and we're running out of time to close the gap. If I'm honest, missing this goal could mean losing our momentum to flip Florida blue – because I'm already being outspent in key areas of the state and the latest polling has us slipping. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110322 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110322] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Friend,
We’re 5 days out from Election Day and that’s important because we all know elections are won or lost in the final days of a campaign. In this case, democracy is going to be won or lost in the next 5 days.
I don’t have any baseball metaphors or breaking news to share. What I can say is we have a plan and our job is to execute it.
Here’s what we’re going to do.
1. We’re going to keep hitting the airwaves with our must see ads showing voters Jocelyn’s impressive track record defending our elections and improving secretary of state services.
2. The campaign is going to spread our get out the vote message to remind every single pro-democracy Michigander that the stakes couldn’t be higher. Democracy is on the ballot.

3. On Election Day, Jocelyn and her fellow election officials are going to ensure that our elections are safe, accessible, and transparent for every voter in our state.

Here’s what you can do to help.

1. Make sure that you, and everyone you know, has made a plan to vote when the polls open November 8th. Visit
https://mvic.sos.state.mi.us for more information.

2. Once you’ve cast your ballot and ensured that everyone around you has as well, pitch in to support Jocelyn’s campaign through the final stretch. Your final contribution is critical to expanding our messaging over these final days, and we can’t leave anything on the table before Election Day.

This is the last time you’ll be hearing from me before Tuesday. Thank you for everything, friend. Now let’s go win this.
-Dan

name: Quentin Wathum-Ocama, YDA President via ActionNetwork.org
subject: Who are the Young Democrats of America
body:
| | | Hey Derek! By now you've probably asked, who are the Young Democrats of America? What constitutes a "Young" Democrat? What is this group about? **Don't worry! We got you covered!** We are the largest youth-led, partisan political organization in the nation. We mobilize young people under the age of 36 to participate in the electoral process to elect Democrats, influence the ideals of the Democratic Party, advocate for progressive issues, and train the next generation of progressive leaders.
Reproductive Rights, Environmental Justice, the Right to Vote, and our futures have been put into greater danger than they have been in our lifetimes. But one thing has been made very clear: **we are the only ones who are going to protect our collective futures.**
As young people, we are called on time and time again to vote, to organize, and to push the agenda of the Democratic Party. As the Young Democrats of America, we know that responsibility lies heavily on our shoulders to organize our peers and to push for our shared progressive values. And we can't do it without you!
Thank you for your support!
Quentin Wathum-Ocama
President, Young Democrats of America

| Dear Fellow American,

As an informed conservative, you _know_ how committed Judicial Watch is to fighting to keep our elections honest.
**And I want you to know that, with a national general election just five days away, the Judicial Watch Election Integrity Initiative legal team is ready to investigate and challenge any and all serious allegations of voter fraud!**
**[But at this critical time, it’s “all hands on deck”...and we need you to support our work with a special contribution today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60933&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60933&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

In the world of election law, Judicial Watch packs a powerful punch when it comes to fighting for honest elections!

And when it comes to fighting for honest elections and ballot integrity, _where others complain, Judicial Watch acts...and acts with real impact_.

**_Real impact_ like forcing states to follow federal law and clean their voter rolls between elections.**

Many states for various reasons...red states, blue states, and purple states...fail to fulfill the list maintenance obligations of the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA).

When that happens, the U.S. Justice Department is empowered to sue states and force them to clean their voter rolls...but that never happens.

So Judicial Watch has taken up the slack!

Our legal actions in **California, Indiana, Ohio** , and **Kentucky** led directly to cleaner voter rolls...and cleaner elections...in those states.

Earlier this year, we scored a major win in **North Carolina** , when we settled a lawsuit after the state had removed more than 430,000 ineligible voter names its voting lists...and we are currently pursuing lawsuits against **Colorado, New York** and **Pennsylvania** over their failure to follow the voter list cleaning requirements of the NVRA.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhtjpoks375qe1a25lc5vbklqis410tld7re4s3o_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5r096gpihecdo4m3098j68vl23ecsjh1vk0rtgo_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsfcllr50u5mhfhs37pqtil94k45qtv26jsfnkg0_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zemi00k2jpoltvkjmqjlp3rd80hoj75ntnl50qkg_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zki156iduf840pqua15p2jlduej5vpt2hnh88u6g_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg52tkdc19jp9mo8dpkse6qhn15c0qj9536f5eb8_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze9qlqs50p27hu0t4bl68uihc3csfe6f097ftq20_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf70gm9c2n0isghul460kh83nhhma18oa4q2nu9o_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1cf62ftvf99ojqp8k4025nk8if9mbngbbm4nqa0_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkpce62n4inr0s8mol1noed0gpnpsts134i56rpg_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhksutqbdqa0b4jslt5qjh7ajlplubujuht4bih0_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z72l45gi3cb5q3ib7ks4ov20n4ek2fmjq9ue8m4g_rp22sh2s8i66or7clim6o36cph2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80145%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1YAZmF4U1HUZRsqqTZ6iUA&sysid=1 "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2022
KWANZA HALL ENDORSES BURT JONES FOR LIEUTENANT GOVERNOR Democrat Congressman and Former Lieutenant Governor Candidate's Endorsement Huge Boost for Jones in Closing Days
JACKSON, Ga - Today, Democrat [Kwanza Hall](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_5z39zDJZplBbxz7HuaQbWcUq0onMImD-ubyRCYq9kGQKl8gOi-B7PQ5uqYE1JU8qqB4Q3hAx0GOEPsJjrYnWARDyg2Po2fw_i6J-8KUzM_Ss5aQRVThS9nNF3t5DBbOyweAQe4TQTp1B8_N251BQA==&c=XAxdN-VxVGVYG31yrEHGTGkq83KgEI_s5Osmw8mNtT7UEV0sp7wmOA==&ch=JHZUOP_imYMGjbC2bvOQmwtPRcRxhkWXQZUVaFTd7BNsk_ScjqHCuw==), the former Congressman and Lieutenant Governor candidate of Georgia, endorsed Republican nominee Burt Jones for Lieutenant Governor. Hall received the [most votes](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_5z39zDJZplBbxz7HuaQbWcUq0onMImD-ubyRCYq9kGQKl8gOi-B7PQ5uqYE1JU8zBXuIpSHFpv3vQSHe6QOFd8t0gn0bYpwyeP5JQ-cMMZlziusWf9ha0FrkuDmo3k9rtaRAP2casf1TTwxJ8usREsOtvdb9hq3g04-IfluPeRs4iIDZm1DYt4W7Q-OsL62kpkJbgU6ChJ_bPFLovBuLnYOtTYlTVT0cP6YVfVr3sfTWUQV15n5E0kQZ2oHeCbOf_kbjXt5TA2ZZhiaZpJ25265kz42vBIC9JLHs3BNbvg=&c=XAxdN-VxVGVYG31yrEHGTGkq83KgEI_s5Osmw8mNtT7UEV0sp7wmOA==&ch=JHZUOP_imYMGjbC2bvOQmwtPRcRxhkWXQZUVaFTd7BNsk_ScjqHCuw==) of any Democrat candidate in the May primary before being defeated by Charlie Bailey in the June runoff. This endorsement is a huge boost for Burt and shows that his campaign is clearly resonating with Republicans, Independents, and Democrats alike. Kwanza's endorsement also demonstrates that Burt's campaign will receive significant crossover appeal from Democrats and African-American voters who support his plan to lower costs and cut taxes, improve K-12 education, strengthen public safety, and create more opportunities for every Georgia family.

| Kwanza Hall said, "I'm proud to endorse Burt Jones to be our state's next Lieutenant Governor. Burt is the only candidate in the race with a plan to invest in our communities, lower costs, improve our K-12 education system and reduce crime. Burt Jones has a proven track record of delivering results for every person in Georgia--and I hope you'll join me in voting for him to be our state's next Lieutenant Governor!"
"I'm honored to have the support of my friend Kwanza Hall in our race for Lieutenant Governor," said Burt Jones. "As a former Congressman and competitor, I appreciate Kwanza's service to our state and his shared commitment to lift up and improve the lives of every Georgia family. I look forward to continuing to work with leaders like Kwanza and others in a bipartisan way to create more opportunities for hardworking Georgians and continue to make our state the best place to live, work and raise a family."

Friends, We are days away from Election Day and 1.8 million Georgians have already voted. While encouraged by the enthusiasm - and [recent polling](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=4156757.667.1.bc763524529e33a7090429c1b67cd7ba) \- there's a lot of time left on the clock...and money continues to pour in for Stacey Abrams. And just like 2018, we know she's going to spend every last penny turning out her radical base of supporters. In a recent interview, Abrams' campaign manager declared: “The bottom line is Stacey Abrams can win outright. She can win in a runoff. This thing is not over." **Well, if it's not over for Abrams...it's not over for us at Stop Stacey! We are going to continue working around the clock to connect with voters to ensure they know about Stacey's radical plan for the Peach State.** Thanks to your generosity, we will have the resources to make an impact at the ballot box and once again #StopStacey from becoming Governor. Friends and Supporters,
Our country is in deep trouble. Many believe we are on the brink of disaster. That is why Caroline ran for Congress. She loves our great country and like you, she is willing to do everything to save it for future generations of Americans, namely our children and grandchildren.
Our campaign has worked hard, Caroline has worked extremely hard. The end of the line is here, and we must leave nothing on the field. We must finish strong to defeat Katherine Clark and that is exactly why we need your help.
Can you go out to a Supermarket in the District this weekend and hand out Caroline's literature?
Can you hold a sign on election day at the polls?
Can you make phone calls? Can you text voters?
Click on any task displayed on the above boxes and let us know you can help. Someone from our campaign will be in touch with you with instructions and lists.

subject: Can A Christian Vote Democrat & Do I Support James Lankford? | From The Desk Of Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer
body:
Tuesday, November 8 is a BIG day in the United States of America. On the ballot is not just Republicans vs Democrats. But what is truly on the ballot
| | |
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15242533.8844.1.9c3d4eed3909e153a84ad2cbda50490a)
---
_Tuesday, November 8_ is a **BIG** day in the United States of America. On the ballot is not just **Republicans vs Democrats**. But what is truly on the ballot is the **heart and soul of America** and whether or not we as a country will take a _step towards God_ or another _step away from God_. Christians must show up and **vote their faith**. That means voting for **life** , the **sanctity of marriage** and other issues that impact our daily living. Due to the _radicalization_ of the Democratic Party it is impossible for a born-again believer of Jesus Christ to get behind the **ANTI-CHRIST agenda** of the Left (this is no longer the Party of JFK). Now, I have been asked _a million times_ if I support **James Lankford** against his democratic opponent in the General Election? The answer is **YES**. James Lankford might be a _pseudo-Republican_ but he is our _pseudo-Republican_ and the Republicans in Oklahoma during primary made the decision for Lankford to be our representative. Therefore, I will be casting **my vote for James Lankford** because regardless of his many flaws, he is still the MUCH better choice. It is very important that we show up on Tuesday, November 8 and **vote our faith**. Vote to **protect the unborn** , vote to **protect children in the classroom** from groomers and predators, vote to **embrace Christian Nationalism** , vote to **support good over evil**. Thank you,

Hi team, it’s Kamala Harris.
In a minute I’m going to ask you to make a donation to The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State, but first let me explain why this election is one of the most important ones in our lives:
If these extremists win, they will be the top election officials to oversee election laws and make decisions about when, where, and how folks vote. They will even have power over certifying the 2024 election results.
Never in our 246-year history has a major political party embraced the notion of throwing out the results of an election. But it is happening in today’s Trump-controlled Republican party - and it’s horrifying.
One thing has been made very clear: these unprecedented attacks on the sacred right to vote are putting our democracy in grave danger. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=em_fr_110422_b1_Kamala_30ac &amount=5]
Luckily, my friends at DASS are working harder than ever to protect our democracy - and defend it from those who want to dismantle it.
They’re leading the charge to elect pro-democracy candidates from Arizona to Michigan who will fend off attempts from election-denying Republicans who try to interfere with our election - but these efforts take massive financial resources. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=em_fr_110422_b1_Kamala_30ac &amount=5]

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6236%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=54CoyBp22gi3Idgp5CI7nw&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80142%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1nzPQXU%2fFyklTfu4X7axng&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80143%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9BZIIeAByJIOJJhNPFfKgw&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80144%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IWVfRGq6kMz0kpQUhLjrxQ&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80255%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=g51Kt6RahmuEF%2f7qOEknGQ&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80256%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uTHAOiDdwQS09tW8TLH%2b3A&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80257%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j%2bs%2b7%2fXvREtQn6qg3igj%2fQ&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80258%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IEbxQxXnevmjfFwKCudjxw&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80259%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qw98KSnEVe14fcrV8QpO%2bA&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80250%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p1Yu%2b1S4yTUAYKV1E5FZXQ&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80251%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4lQgtodRJLAViwGTYg0bxw&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80252%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kbTCEKhuaGesBYItFjCjQA&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80253%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JP6xyi1q4Z2xT6Pan9skxw&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

House Conservative Surveys | **Election Integrity Watch**

\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

On May 24th, 2022, we lost our beautiful 9 year old daughter to senseless gun violence.

Jacklyn was a free spirit that was always willing and wanting to help others. Her favorite color was sage green, she loved to sing, make videos on TikTok and interact with her friends on Snapchat.

**Jacklyn was one of the 21 victims of the Uvalde school shooting.** And while we know there’s nothing we can do to bring our daughter back, we couldn’t stand idly by during one of the most important elections of our lifetime.

That’s why we’re writing to you now. John is the candidate we’re supporting because he’s not afraid to stand up to the NRA, and he’s promised to take action to stop the gun violence epidemic.

I know how talented Josh is as a brother, a father, and a candidate for office.

My name’s Rebecca, and I’m Josh Shapiro’s sister. I was also his first Campaign Manager for his very first election back in 2004! I know how talented Josh is as a brother, a father, and a candidate for office — listening to voters and living his values of truth, compassion, and hard work — not to mention his impressive basketball skills and stellar work on the grill! I also know that my brother alone can’t win this race. It’s too competitive and too big to be a one-person operation. He’ll need a whole team working around the clock and tens of thousands of grassroots supporters from all across Pennsylvania and the nation to win. That’s where you come in, Derek. Without you, Josh can’t win in just four days — and then we run the risk of seeing Pennsylvanians’ rights and our democracy come crashing down under a Republican trifecta. **[Please, join me and Josh — because this is a team effort and we can’t win this race without you. I know a thing or two about how much Josh cares about Pennsylvania.
When he was just starting out in public service, the most important thing to Josh was that he got to know his community. Each night he walked out of our tiny campaign office to knock on doors and meet voters — by the end of the election, he knocked on 18,000 doors and walked through 3 pairs of shoes!
Josh was laser focused. He felt the only way to protect a community was to understand their needs.
18 years later, his perspective has not changed. No matter how or where he connects with Pennsylvanians (traveling on that huge bus is a major upgrade from our early days, though!) Josh has never stopped listening to or fighting for the people he represents.
That’s why I’m so proud to support my brother. I’ve believed in Josh since day one — and I know just how much work he puts into serving Pennsylvania.
**[I support Josh’s candidacy with my whole heart. Now, can you do the same? With just four days left in this all-important race, join me in helping my brother win so we can see a more equitable, prosperous Pennsylvania — will you donate a few bucks now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54019974/377202004/1441362397?refcode=email_110422_4daysrebecca_allsuper&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=97180cff-4c5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzE4MGNmZi00YzVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VOXZlaS__b7yCj-c4tDI11tSxbTuTdUjY91ytSev5-o=)**
Thanks for supporting my brother as we finish out this election,
Rebecca Shapiro Steinberg

Veteran political analyst and former host of MSNBC's "Hardball" Chris Matthews shares his views on the upcoming midterm elections followed by leaders of grassroots get-out-the-vote groups in critical target states - Kadida Kenner from the New Pennsylvania Project, Reverend Greg Lewis of Souls to the Polls in Wisconsin and Kate Feldman from You Can Vote in North Carolina.
Pod for the Cause | S6 E02: Why Our Courts Matter | Listen Here [https://civilrights.org/podcast/s06e02/]

Two months ahead of the midterm election, West Chester native Kadida Kenner, CEO of New Pennsylvania Project, is working hard to ensure voting is accessible to everybody, writes Cherri Gregg for WHYY.
First and vote: Dems to make registration play at PSU, Pitt games | PennLive [https://www.penncapital-star.com/election-2022/first-and-vote-dems-to-make-registration-play-at-psu-pitt-games-friday-morning-coffee/]
Younger voters across central Pennsylvania told PennLive earlier this week that they’re energized and ready to vote. They’re motivated by such issues as education, clean water, and abortion access. “I think right now the biggest hurdle is we are not engaging students in a meaningful way,” Kadida Kenner, of the New Pennsylvania Project, told PennLive.
Mark Your Calendars!
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Election Day! Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
News Roundup
Pa. election 2022: A basic guide to vetting candidates for U.S. Senate, governor, and more [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-fetterman-oz-candidates-vetting-guide/] | All eyes will be on Pennsylvania this November election as a number of contentious races on the ballot will determine the state’s political future. While (the Senate and Governor’s) races may be getting the most media attention, Pennsylvanians will also vote for their U.S. House representatives and lawmakers in the state legislature, where Democrats seek to chip away at the Republican majority in both the state House and Senate. It’s vital to thoroughly research the candidates on your ballot, and we’re here to help. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-fetterman-oz-candidates-vetting-guide/]
Wolf takes lawsuit on constitutional changes to lower court [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-lawsuits-legislature-constitutions-tom-wolf-67090c6ff94204eea683ba7f34e0abd7] [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/doug-mastriano-pennsylvania-gop-governor-candidate-secretary-of-state_n_62e4447fe4b0c60a5668334e?utm_campaign=share_email&ncid=other_email_o63gt2jcad4] | Democratic Gov. Tom Wolf is taking another shot at a lawsuit that argues Republican lawmakers improperly bundled together five proposed state constitutional amendments to get them approved by the Pennsylvania Legislature. (via AP News) [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-lawsuits-legislature-constitutions-tom-wolf-67090c6ff94204eea683ba7f34e0abd7]
Pa. election 2022: There will be no constitutional amendments on the Nov. 8 ballot, but big ones are looming [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-constitutional-amendments-abortion-voter-id/] | Pennsylvania voters will not see any proposed constitutional amendments on this year’s November ballot, but that is almost certain to change when the state legislature opens its new two-year session in January. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-constitutional-amendments-abortion-voter-id/]
Pa. election 2022: How to serve as a poll worker on Nov. 8 [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-poll-worker-guide-how-to-explainer] | When Pennsylvania holds its 2022 general election in November, thousands of poll workers will ensure that voting runs smoothly. You could be one of them. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-poll-worker-guide-how-to-explainer]
Pa. Republicans are gaining on Democrats in registered voters. We look at what that really means. [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/pennsylvania-voter-registration-data-democrats-republicans-20220928.html] | Republicans are closing a voter registration gap with Democrats, and have added voters in nearly every county over the last two decades, though many have likely been voting Republican for years. (via The Philadelphia Inquirer) [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/pennsylvania-voter-registration-data-democrats-republicans-20220928.html]
Philly is about to triple the number of languages it supports in elections [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/philadelphia-elections-language-expansion-plan-voting-20220928.html] | The plan translates materials into Russian, Vietnamese, Khmer, Arabic, Haitian Creole, and Portuguese, though it wouldn’t put them on ballots or voting machines. (via The Philadelphia Inquirer) [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/philadelphia-elections-language-expansion-plan-voting-20220928.html]
Pa. election 2022: Where governor candidates Mastriano, Shapiro stand on crime, justice issues [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-governor-race-crime-prison-bail-reform/] | Month after month, Pennsylvanians cite their safety and related topics — crime, guns, drugs, and violence — as one of the top problems facing the commonwealth. These concerns have colored this year’s governor’s race, in which candidates have discussed curbing violent crime and fighting inequities based in the justice system. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-governor-race-crime-prison-bail-reform/]

clean_body: [] It's time to make your voting plan ! Only four weeks left to register to vote, and six more weeks until Election Day! Encourage your friends and family to register to vote and check their registration status. When we all vote, we win! Make my voting plan [bit.ly/NPPVotePA] NPP In The News [] An Evening with Chris Matthews | Watch Now [] Veteran political analyst and former host of MSNBC's "Hardball" Chris Matthews shares his views on the upcoming midterm elections followed by leaders of grassroots get-out-the-vote groups in critical target states - Kadida Kenner from the New Pennsylvania Project, Reverend Greg Lewis of Souls to the Polls in Wisconsin and Kate Feldman from You Can Vote in North Carolina. Pod for the Cause | S6 E02: Why Our Courts Matter | Listen Here [] On the latest episode of Pod For The Cause, NPP CEO Kadida Kenner and Kim Tignor of She Will Rise join host Kanya Bennett to discuss why courts matter, especially in this moment. We don’t think so! | The Philadelphia Sun [] A group of civic and religious leaders came together in support of embattled Philadelphia District Attorney to send a message to Pennsylvania legislators hoping to impeach him: ‘Not on our watch! West Chester Woman Wants to Make Voting Accessible to All | Vista Today [] Two months ahead of the midterm election, West Chester native Kadida Kenner, CEO of New Pennsylvania Project, is working hard to ensure voting is accessible to everybody, writes Cherri Gregg for WHYY. First and vote: Dems to make registration play at PSU, Pitt games | PennLive [] Younger voters across central Pennsylvania told PennLive earlier this week that they’re energized and ready to vote. They’re motivated by such issues as education, clean water, and abortion access. “I think right now the biggest hurdle is we are not engaging students in a meaningful way,” Kadida Kenner, of the New Pennsylvania Project, told PennLive. Mark Your Calendars! October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot November 8, 2022: Election Day! Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.) News Roundup Pa. election 2022: A basic guide to vetting candidates for U.S. Senate, governor, and more [] | All eyes will be on Pennsylvania this November election as a number of contentious races on the ballot will determine the state’s political future. While (the Senate and Governor’s) races may be getting the most media attention, Pennsylvanians will also vote for their U.S. House representatives and lawmakers in the state legislature, where Democrats seek to chip away at the Republican majority in both the state House and Senate. It’s vital to thoroughly research the candidates on your ballot, and we’re here to help. (via Spotlight PA) [] Wolf takes lawsuit on constitutional changes to lower court [] [] | Democratic Gov. Tom Wolf is taking another shot at a lawsuit that argues Republican lawmakers improperly bundled together five proposed state constitutional amendments to get them approved by the Pennsylvania Legislature. (via AP News) [] Pa. election 2022: There will be no constitutional amendments on the Nov. 8 ballot, but big ones are looming [] | Pennsylvania voters will not see any proposed constitutional amendments on this year’s November ballot, but that is almost certain to change when the state legislature opens its new two-year session in January. (via Spotlight PA) [] Pa. election 2022: How to serve as a poll worker on Nov. 8 [] | When Pennsylvania holds its 2022 general election in November, thousands of poll workers will ensure that voting runs smoothly. You could be one of them. (via Spotlight PA) [] Pa. Republicans are gaining on Democrats in registered voters. We look at what that really means. [] | Republicans are closing a voter registration gap with Democrats, and have added voters in nearly every county over the last two decades, though many have likely been voting Republican for years. (via The Philadelphia Inquirer) [] Philly is about to triple the number of languages it supports in elections [] | The plan translates materials into Russian, Vietnamese, Khmer, Arabic, Haitian Creole, and Portuguese, though it wouldn’t put them on ballots or voting machines. (via The Philadelphia Inquirer) [] Pa. election 2022: Where governor candidates Mastriano, Shapiro stand on crime, justice issues [] | Month after month, Pennsylvanians cite their safety and related topics — crime, guns, drugs, and violence — as one of the top problems facing the commonwealth. These concerns have colored this year’s governor’s race, in which candidates have discussed curbing violent crime and fighting inequities based in the justice system. **Biden Begging for Votes **_Amid skyrocketing crime and inflation, Joe Biden is coming to Illinois to beg for your vote._
---
**Oswego, Ill**. – Kendall County Board Chairman Scott Gryder issued a statement on Biden's upcoming visit to Illinois: "Crime is rising, inflation is at a record high, and Lauren Underwood is to blame. Instead of looking to change course and put IL-14 first, she's doubling down on her failed agenda and turning to our unpopular President to bolster her sagging prospects. Lauren Underwood has voted for massive spending bills that have driven up inflation, she’s campaigned with defund-the-police radicals, and she's supported legislation that sent COVID relief checks to prisoners. Joe Biden has signed off on all of it, and that's why he's one of the least popular presidents in our history. But the people of IL-14 aren't fooled. They know a vote for the Democrats is a vote for more federal spending, more inflation, and more hardship. President Biden is coming to Illinois to reaffirm his support for these destructive policies and the people who helped put them in place. As your Congressman, I will stand up to Joe Biden and ensure small businesses have a voice, federal spending is curtailed, and the people of the 14th are heard in Washington, D.C."###

Together, we can send Katie Porter back to Congress — and we can bring Summer Lee and Jamie McLeod-Skinner’s voices to Washington.
Watching **Katie Porter** ’s career unfold has been one of my greatest joys — ever since the first time she walked into my early-morning bankruptcy class, bright-eyed and ready to go. She’s been a fierce consumer advocate for decades. After the 2008 housing crisis, she held big banks’ feet to the fire to make sure they paid California families the money they were owed. And as a member of Congress, she’s held CEOs accountable, fought to lower the cost of child care, and taken on corporate price gouging.
But after the latest round of redistricting, with her district split down the middle between Democrats and Republicans, Katie’s in her toughest campaign yet. And expert forecasters just moved this race into the “toss-up” category. We’ve got to make sure she pulls through. We’ve got to keep her in Congress.
**Summer Lee** is a proven champion for racial, economic, and environmental justice for all Pennsylvanians — from advocating for better pay and safer working conditions to defeating dangerous corporate fracking proposals. She’s been a terrific state representative, and she’d make us proud as a congresswoman.
But the same Super PAC that tried to defeat Summer in her primary is now dumping truckloads of cash against her at the last minute. A recent poll had her up by just a few points, with 16 percent undecided — so if Summer can’t fight back against these new attacks, they could send her to defeat.
And here’s a weird coincidence: her Republican opponent has the same name as the retiring Democratic congressman in that district. It’s already tripped up some voters who meant to vote Democratic. So Summer’s team has to work even harder to make sure people know that she is the Democratic nominee.
Over in Oregon, **Jamie McLeod-Skinner** has built a strong campaign from the grassroots level — I saw it firsthand when I went to her district and spoke with a bunch of volunteers getting ready to go knock on doors. Jamie’s a small business owner, experienced public servant, and emergency response coordinator who’s running hard against corporate special interests like Big Pharma.
But we’ve got to help her fight back against all the outside spending pouring in against her — because our side is getting beaten on the airwaves. This could be one of the tightest congressional races in the country, and it could decide who controls the U.S. House. Every dollar we send Jamie’s way can help get her message out to more voters by Election Day.
**We still have the power to make a difference in the outcome of these races — and that gives me hope.**
[_**Please split a $3 contribution between Katie Porter, Summer Lee, Jamie McLeod-Skinner, and Warren Democrats today to help defend our House majority and elect champions for working people across the country.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54022314/377210462/682409729?refcode=EMZ10C_TAN_E_20221103_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDkyZTllMC01MDVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aqOXSkjxK-bQwNSc-7xwXGl_jQD6OvGVoy5vCAkbDMs=)
I’m deeply grateful for everything you’ve already done leading up to these midterm elections. Just a few days left. Let’s give this fight everything we’ve got.

But this isn't just a moral issue; it's also an economic issue: **More than a million mothers would rejoin the workforce if childcare were affordable** –**** giving families more financial security, offering mothers the opportunity to lead their own careers, and securing our economy a $48 billion boost every single year.

We’re doing absolutely everything we can to elect John and win this race, but we’re being massively outspent by Dr. Oz and all the shady Super PACs supporting his campaign. Which is why we need your help: We won’t BS you, Derek. With an estimated personal fortune of $100-400 million, Oz has virtually unlimited funds to buy this seat. And that’s not even counting the Super PACs, MAGA celebs, and billionaire buddies lining up behind his campaign. To make matters worse, Donald Trump is flying into PA tomorrow to support Doc Hollywood. 🚨 Unlike Oz, John doesn’t have million$ to personally fund his campaign — instead, he is relying on grassroots contributions from supporters like you to step up in these final days. Thank you for your support. Let’s run through the tape, Derek. Together, Team Fetterman 💛 | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

A vote for ‘Brian Dahle’ means...
* A vote for cheaper gas.

This is what voters should be asking themselves:

There’s only one answer - Gavin Newsom has failed on nearly every important decision and policy that has come across his desk in the last four years.

| | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win next Tuesday.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc132c424-3c99-4036-8fbe-7be2a60864d9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

Friends —

As we were closing the office for the day, someone sent us a recent news article published by the Daily Kos.

The news article couldn’t paint a more clear picture of who Tony Gonzales truly is — even taking us back to 2020 when Gonzales squirmed for what felt like an eternity when a reporter asked if he would label the KKK a terrorist group. And his final response?

Eventually, Gonzales shrugged it off by blaming his lack of desire on Covid-19, saying, “We’re living in COVID. There’s a million things going on. You have this much oxygen in the room. And it’s not to talk about the KKK.”

I know you've heard from a lot of people about how Catherine Cortez Masto's (D-NV) Senate race is the most important in the country – but with just days until the election, I wanted you to hear it from me, too.
While you might associate me with my roles as an actor – particularly a former (fictional) president – I speak to you today as a concerned fellow American: **If Catherine Cortez Masto loses in Nevada, we hand over control of the Senate to Mitch McConnell, and worse still, pave the way for a second Trump era. **
[**I am going to do everything in my power to make sure that doesn't happen, which is why I'm emailing. Will you split a donation between Catherine’s campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's to keep the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54029186/377237496/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3750-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmMwZmFkOC01YTVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZyYHNUMLXJcfFhM4OA5IZO9XLOfCWnZarD3cV3PV_Vc=)
You know as well as I do why we can't let that happen. The last time Republicans controlled our democratic institutions – headed by McConnell and the impeached former president – was marked by deception, selfishness and every hindrance of progress possible. This period culminated in an attack on democracy itself, sanctioned by many of those who could be part of the Senate majority if Sen. Cortez Masto loses this seat.
The darkness of those years should serve as a reminder for why our Democratic majority is so crucial – but the hopefulness of recent days should be our clarion call. Sen. Cortez Masto and her Democratic colleagues have helmed historic action on infrastructure, climate change, and lowering prescription drug prices. They confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court. And so much more.
**With hope and hard work, we've accomplished a great deal. But with Sen. Cortez Masto down 1 point in the polls and up against more than $50 million in GOP attacks, she _needs_ our help to win. **
[**Let's help Catherine raise $50,000 before her midnight fundraising deadline. Please split $5 between her campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's, or whatever you can spare, to save our Democratic majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54029188/377237499/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3750-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmMwZmFkOC01YTVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZyYHNUMLXJcfFhM4OA5IZO9XLOfCWnZarD3cV3PV_Vc=)
I've been an activist most of my life, friend. I've witnessed our nation confront and overcome a host of consequential challenges. And I've learned that, at such critical junctures of history, we must ask ourselves: _Who do we want to be as a country_?
Do we want to be a country where the very right to bodily autonomy lies in the hands of right-wing extremists? The kind of country where health care and lifesaving medications are so expensive, they are out of reach for countless Americans? The kind of country where outright lies and conspiracies are used to tear down our democracy?
I say _no. No_ to the country that MAGA Republican rule would manifest. No to extremism and attacks on democracy and fundamental rights. **But – and I say this with no exaggeration – this all rides on whether Catherine Cortez Masto wins this battleground Senate race in Nevada.**
Experts from The New York Times to CNN are reporting Catherine is the most vulnerable Democratic senator on the ballot, so we urgently need to do our part to help her win. Martin Sheen

# [Theresa Supports Students: Focusing on integrity and credibility](https://theresacoatesellis.com/2022/11/04/theresa-supports-students-focusing-on-integrity-and-credibility/)
| | theresacoatesellis Nov 4
---|---
I graduated from George Mason University cum laude with a degree in Business Communication and was awarded Alumna of the Year in 2019 for all the work that I achieved with students and the community to open doors for opportunity to thrive. And I continue that passion today as an elected Councilwoman in Manassas City.
Alumna of the Year 2019, George Mason University Communication Department
The Communication Department is not an easy department to impress. They are hard-core journalists, media specialists, creatives, technical gurus, and critical of any work that is not credible.
With my experience in education, and as an award-winning communication expert, I am disappointed when elected leaders and the media who we wish were trustworthy sources — create writings, posts, hacked up videos, and messaging that are edited to manipulate and deceive the people who they serve.
Example: when reporting on City Council meetings — if they happen in a small conference room, it is a work session for information and direction. If there is no agenda item for a “surprise” point of discussion or recorded votes on the minutes, it is “political theater” and wasting taxpayer money and paid staff’s time.
Mentoring local young leaders in Rotary in City Council Chambers for official meetings.
You know deception when you see writing with no sources, and butchered video with sound bites on social media with no sources.
When I mentor students, this is an example of what they should never do to be relevant, credible or trustworthy.
Mentoring with Leadership, Integrity, and Accomplishments in the Community with Students:
Founded CCN Media Team, Osbourn High School
. Formed the Osbourn Media Team Community Connection Network (CCN) in 2015 with Mr. Emanuel, media teacher, while serving as an appointed Manassas City Public School Education Foundation member, to cover local stories and school news. I mentored these students to report with good sources —not unverified or purposely manipulated.
As a Manassas City Public School Education Foundation Board Member presenting our new Media students to teachers and staff at Hylton Performing Arts Center
. Launched the annual ISCC Volunteer and Scholarship Fair to connect service organizations and nonprofits with students for opportunities.
. Founded my Councilwoman initiative: now the 5th annual Shadow for a Day connecting students to careers.
. Mason community speaker to Communication students for strategy, media and ethics invited by professors during sessions.
Awards and Recognition:
. Bull Run Rotary Club Volunteer of the Year 2016
Appointed Area Governor Rotary PWC and Manassas 3 year term to 2020
. Voted two term President ISCC 2017, 2018
. Mason Alumni of the Year 2019 and Featured Community Speaker.
. The most rewarding experiences have been working with people, sharing expertise, listening to them and connecting them for opportunities in a career, in higher education or training or in volunteering to make their life better and make a positive impact on their community or the world.
Please consider Theresa Coates Ellis for Manassas City Council re-election in early voting to Nov. 5 at 9025 Center St. or at your regular precinct — usually your nearby public school. Visit Elections.Virginia.gov to find out where to vote.

| | This is it, Peter, If this election were a marathon, we’d be able to see the finish line. And with only 4 days left, the races are _neck-and-neck._ **_The New York Times_****called Pennsylvania one of the most decisive states for the 2022 midterms, and we couldn’t agree more.** What happens here next week will have huge implications. If elected governor, the 2024 Presidential Election could rest solely in Doug Mastriano’s power-hungry hands. He believes that women who have abortions should be charged with murder — and he’s said he’d kick every Pennsylvania voter off the voter rolls. If elected to Congress, puppy-killer Mehmet Oz could be the Republican vote that flips the Senate red, giving the GOP a whole host of opportunities to destroy any progress made since 2020. Republicans would be able to pass a national abortion ban, a “Don’t Say Gay” bill, and more. We also can’t take a single one of our incumbents in Congress for granted – Congressman Matt Cartwright and Congresswoman Susan Wild’s seats must be protected at all costs. **The bottom line? This is going to be a close one, and there’s too much on the line to sit this one out.**

name: Vice President Mike Pence
subject: Protecting our right to pray
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Advancing American Freedom
body:
| |
---
| | | | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61796609:J1LngTGgN:m:1:3350876382:777BA69AF9EEB6CC8D20A25AA82A0E27:r)

I'm convinced of two things: that America is a freedom-loving nation and America is a nation of faith.

Everywhere I go, people speak to me about their faith with a word of encouragement. The sweetest words I ever hear is when people say, "I'm praying for you." And I want you all to know: __Karen and I feel those prayers every day.__

Sadly, some activist judges and government bureaucrats want to make it harder for Americans to exercise their right to pray.

In fact, we recently saw a high school football coach get FIRED for privately praying on the field after a game.

I refused to just sit back and let our right to prayer be stripped away by big government.

Through my group, Advancing American Freedom, we petitioned the Supreme Court to reaffirm that coach's right to prayer. I'm pleased to report that the Supreme Court sided with the coach and reaffirmed all Americans' right to live out our faith.

_**But the fight is not over.**_

We must remain vigilant for the next attempt to restrict our right to pray. That's why I'm asking you to make a donation to Advancing American Freedom today to help us continue to defend religious freedom.

---
| | [CHIP IN TODAY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61796609:J1LngTGgN:m:1:3350876382:777BA69AF9EEB6CC8D20A25AA82A0E27:r)
---

It is critical that we have the support of Americans who will never waver. _**[Whether you can spare $100 or just $25](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61796609:J1LngTGgN:m:1:3350876382:777BA69AF9EEB6CC8D20A25AA82A0E27:r "Whether you can spare $100 or just $10")**_ , I assure you we will never stop fighting to protect the right to pray.
_The Bible tells us that the prayer of the upright pleases Him; the prayer reaches Heaven, His holy dwelling place; and that in times of great challenge in our life or in the life of the nation, we 're not to be anxious about anything, but in everything, in every form of prayer and petition with thanksgiving, we're to present our request to God and know that the peace of God that passes all understanding will guard our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus._
So please step up today and help us protect the right to prayer. If you cannot give financially at this time, I understand, but I ask that you never stop praying for our country.

I appreciate all you have done and continue to do for our country.

God bless,
Mike Pence

As the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection – according to experts like _NPR –_ I have fundraising goals I need to reach every day to keep pace with the over $37 million Herschel Walker has raised to defeat me.
**So is there _anything_ I can say to convince you to make a grassroots contribution before midnight tonight?**
What if I told you that _FiveThirtyEight_ confirmed Senate control will come down to our battleground race in Georgia?

What if I told you that polling shows me neck and neck against Trump's hand-picked candidate?

Dear fellow American,

Did you know there is a specific legislative provision ensuring that your federal tax dollars do not fund abortions?

Since 1976, the Hyde Amendment has protected American taxpayers from paying for abortions. Throughout its history, the Hyde Amendment has received widespread bipartisan support from both Congress and the White House. But if President Biden, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.), Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.), and their pro-abortion allies in Congress have their way, this critically important provision could be undone.

[**Please, right now, sign this No Taxpayer Funding of Abortion emergency petition to House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMzA4LTcyYTQ4NjhmZDgxZDRkMDlhNTI5ZjE3NWUyMjQ1M2QyIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwOi8vd3d3LmZyY2FjdGlvbi5vcmcvZC0yMjExXzMifQ/xxrx3B86l4jtuzqKKRDbJg)
[**Sign the No Taxpayer Funding of Abortion petition**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMzA4LTcyYTQ4NjhmZDgxZDRkMDlhNTI5ZjE3NWUyMjQ1M2QyIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwOi8vd3d3LmZyY2FjdGlvbi5vcmcvZC0yMjExXzMifQ/PAHSzPcxMMht8WFoP8iElQ)
The pro-abortion lobby is hard at work trying to roll back the Hyde Amendment, as well as the many pro-life victories achieved during the Trump administration, including:
* The Protecting Life in Global Health Assistance (PLGHA) policy, which blocked funding for international organizations that perform or promote abortion;
* A Title X rule change that closed an abortion funding loophole by ensuring financial and physical separation between family planning clinics and abortion facilities;
* An executive order that reinforced existing protections for children born prematurely, with disabilities, or in medical distress, including infants who survive abortion; and
* A conscience exemption from the Obamacare "contraceptive mandate" for organizations with moral or religious objections to purchasing insurance that includes coverage of contraceptives and abortion-causing drugs.

According to a January 2021 Marist poll, 58% of Americans oppose taxpayer funding of abortion. But unless you and I - and many thousands of other Americans who value life - speak up now, the Pelosi-led House and Schumer-led Senate are very likely to ignore the will of the people and act against our values and the lives of the unborn — especially as a "lame-duck" session of Congress looms on the horizon!

[**You and I must take a stand NOW to preserve pro-life policy and ensure the Hyde Amendment remains intact for future generations.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMzA4LTcyYTQ4NjhmZDgxZDRkMDlhNTI5ZjE3NWUyMjQ1M2QyIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjMiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwOi8vd3d3LmZyY2FjdGlvbi5vcmcvZC0yMjExXzMifQ/EYIXMqHKKmV-VCZEi6zPHA)

President Biden's proposed federal budget for this year removed the Hyde Amendment-following through on a campaign promise made by every Democratic presidential candidate in 2020. We must act now to demand that our tax dollars NOT fund abortions.

Family Research Council Action has been working feverishly to defeat the pro-abortion special interests and their allies in Congress.

We've been working with pro-life legislators in Congress to help secure the passage of important legislation, and we've been working at the state level all across America to protect life as well.

With Democrats in control of Congress for another two months, innocent unborn lives are at risk in America like never before.

If you and I remain silent, innocent children will tragically die.

[**Please help us fight back against President Joe Biden, Speaker Nancy Pelosi, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, and their pro-abortion allies today.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMzA4LTcyYTQ4NjhmZDgxZDRkMDlhNTI5ZjE3NWUyMjQ1M2QyIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjQiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwOi8vd3d3LmZyY2FjdGlvbi5vcmcvZC0yMjExXzMifQ/BlWA1qlWLZC0w_PXSwyseA)
[**Sign the No Taxpayer Funding of Abortion petition**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIyMzA4LTcyYTQ4NjhmZDgxZDRkMDlhNTI5ZjE3NWUyMjQ1M2QyIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjUiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwOi8vd3d3LmZyY2FjdGlvbi5vcmcvZC0yMjExXzMifQ/1bhb5y4lOxTR2Y5vitBRlQ)
Thank you, and God bless!

For America,

Lt. Gen. (Ret.) William G. Boykin
Executive Vice President
Family Research Council Action

subject: Breaking down the next 4 days

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_1&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_1&amount=28]
Team,
The time has finally arrived.
We’re entering the period known as the “final four.” It’s pretty self explanatory -- it means the last four days before the election. It’s also known as “GOTV,” or Get Out The Vote.
That means Team Slotkin is about to have a *constant* presence around the new 7th. We’ll have 8 locations in the 2,813 square miles of the district that will serve as home bases for our organizers and volunteers as they make our final push to knock on thousands of doors and make even more phone calls.
The name of the game is turnout. We’re looking to get in touch with voters who haven't cast a ballot yet, making sure they have a plan to get to the polls and resolve any questions or issues they might have -- or, let them know how to drop off their absentee ballots. (One fifth of registered voters in this district have already voted via absentee ballot!)
We’re not taking our foot off the gas for even a moment – and that means having the resources we need to make it happen. The money we raise in these four days goes directly out the door into the voter contact efforts I just mentioned almost instantly. It goes right into the tangible things that our volunteers might need - all 663 of the folks doing a volunteer shift with us over the last four days. Rain pouches, coffee and donuts, pizza, hand warmers, you name it!
In honor of our final four, I’m asking if you will contribute $4, $40, or even $140 to help us finish out strong. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_1&amount=28] Elections are won and lost in these final four days, and in one of the most competitive races in the country, we’re not leaving anything to chance.

Elissa
