Dear Friends,
As we head into the last weekend before Election Day, I wanted to quickly remind everyone that early voting locations are open across our community through Sunday — and if you still have a vote-by-mail ballot, the best way to make sure it’s received on time is to bring it to an early voting location or your Supervisor of Elections Office!
With so much at stake — reproductive rights, preventing gun violence, lowering costs, and more — it’s crucial that we make sure everyone’s voice is heard in this election.
So please, click below to find where you can drop off your ballot or vote in person this weekend.
Vote Early Broward [https://www.browardvotes.gov/Voting-Methods/Early-Voting-Dates-Hours-and-Sites]
Vote Early Palm Beach [https://www.pbcelections.org/Voters/Early-Voting]
Right now, those in power are doing everything they can to stop people from voting, so we can’t let up when it comes to winning this race and protecting our Democratic majority in Congress.
In Washington, I’ll protect abortion rights, fight for gun violence prevention, and lower costs for working families. But I can only get there if we make sure every voice is heard in this election.
So please, if you haven’t voted yet, click here to make a plan to do so. [https://makeaplantovote.com/]
Thanks,
Jared Moskowitz

Friend,
My name is Cisco Aguilar, and I’m running for Secretary of State in Nevada. In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[split a donation between my campaign and Jacky Rosen's](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54035420/377261116/-33146501?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2191-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDA4ZTM0Zi02NjVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6lb8ZogL_uqgkh8pffBqYNCswqE02b3slUPaaTuZrLY=)** , but first, I need you to know what we’re up against.

**President Obama himself had this to say about Jim Marchant: “He’s trying to one-up all the Republicans peddling lies about the 2020 election by saying that all elections in Nevada for the last 15 years have been fake... That’s not somebody you want in charge of your elections.”**
Nevada's democracy is under threat from extremists like Jim Marchant, and if he wins, the future of free elections is at risk in 2024, 2026, and beyond.

body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54035900/377262681/511358464?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2ZWIxOWZjLTY3NWMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=w1mhgktCSwRQvN-ZQDh5CD8qQjSE8SunT5y5GgUZCxk=&emci=d4f31ed1-db5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d6eb19fc-675c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230) | | | Hi Peter, This weekend’s forecast is calling for lots of voting! **It’s a perfect time to curl up with a cozy blanket, plus your ballot, a blue or black pen, and[OLCV’s endorsements.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54035901/377262682/-466892316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2ZWIxOWZjLTY3NWMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=w1mhgktCSwRQvN-ZQDh5CD8qQjSE8SunT5y5GgUZCxk=&emci=d4f31ed1-db5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d6eb19fc-675c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** After marking your votes for climate champions up and down the ballot (and signing your return envelope), you can then pop your ballot into the mail – it doesn’t even need a stamp. Or, you can venture out to drop it off at a nearby **[official drop box.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54035903/377262684/1486974124?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2ZWIxOWZjLTY3NWMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=w1mhgktCSwRQvN-ZQDh5CD8qQjSE8SunT5y5GgUZCxk=&emci=d4f31ed1-db5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d6eb19fc-675c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** Sound like a plan? Whatever your plan is to vote, make sure your ballot is dropped off or postmarked by 8pm on Election Day – this Tuesday, November 8th. Voting is easy, even fun, and definitely important. **With the race for Oregon’s next governor as close as they come, every vote is crucial this election.** There’s only one candidate for governor who shares Oregonians’ environmental values and our commitment to climate action. Her name is **Tina Kotek,** and we urge you to vote for her. With wildfires, extreme weather, and other climate impacts hitting us hard, we need Tina’s leadership in the governor’s office now more than ever. **A vote for Tina is a vote for climate leadership.** Check out our **[endorsement page here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54035904/377262686/-466892316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2ZWIxOWZjLTY3NWMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=w1mhgktCSwRQvN-ZQDh5CD8qQjSE8SunT5y5GgUZCxk=&emci=d4f31ed1-db5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d6eb19fc-675c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** for all the pro-environment and pro-climate candidates who have earned OLCV’s endorsement. These are the candidates ready to tackle the climate crisis and protect what we love about Oregon for future generations. Have you already voted for Tina and returned your ballot? Thank you for being an early voter! Now, it’s time to remind your friends and family to vote. As someone they know and trust, you are the best messenger to reach them. **So, Peter, can you call or text three friends or family members reminding them to vote?** We have until this Tuesday at 8pm to get out the vote for **[Tina and all the climate champions running in this election.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54035905/377262688/-466892316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2ZWIxOWZjLTY3NWMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=w1mhgktCSwRQvN-ZQDh5CD8qQjSE8SunT5y5GgUZCxk=&emci=d4f31ed1-db5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d6eb19fc-675c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** This is it. Time to be a voter! Extra democracy points for motivating others to vote, too. Happy voting! Lindsey Scholten

Dominic Rapini

Why I'm worried
| | |
---
Friend: Last month, I went head-to-head with Marco Rubio on the debate stage – where I countered his lies and fear tactics with _real_ ideas on how to build a better future for Florida.
That's why this update from my finance director this morning was so surprising: **Despite a surge in donations after the debate, things are slowing down and I'm still WAY behind on tonight's $500,000 goal – but friend, a generous group of fired-up Democratic donors has offered to TRIPLE-MATCH all contributions to my campaign up to our $500,000 goal.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54017290/377191326/549218121?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5163-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTNlOGJmOC00ODVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RgjxDMAwLaKSZpdmrO3NuucxI0XYRZpfoc-Gt4W02go=)
**If I don't make up this shortfall,** **I'm worried my team will have to make some tough decisions about our budget to mobilize voters and fight back against Rubio's relentless attack ads.

[I knew winning in Florida was never going to be easy – and if I'm going to have a shot, I have to keep pace. I don't like asking for money – but if we're going to retire Rubio and defend our Senate majority, I need grassroots Democrats like you to step up with a $5 donation now, while all donations are being TRIPLE-MATCHED, to help get me back on track to win.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54017292/377191328/549218121?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5163-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTNlOGJmOC00ODVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RgjxDMAwLaKSZpdmrO3NuucxI0XYRZpfoc-Gt4W02go=)**

Peter,

**Have I asked for too much?** I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, **with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling.**

Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. **Just 10 of you reading this contributed.** When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out.

**According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just $12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans.**

While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. **[[Help fund our field program]](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=231591526d8d4081979961a0877aad7f&_e=NPkMn0Sat0TC1UOqIVezxkCeQdJUdDjGKU2DWmWj6RujpGKSH5BpeIykwBEJlD63z317D-l-Rm-J8ztY7edEy4pmEUZOd2ZridlGICNsaD-906fRQvPn9jmwmsfWBka5rqppJDImkmjxKY7GLHnpzE2MDOLqMA4m3Li_S0omCGel7a4XYQGVjBsTibcD4_fDFUKkBFMk259J1KRwX5LzoZpSOATSQR25InAClD4Icjey58r_3e6i0COuiT8pNfzPvfeDwDjgRxlPsJjGCEWIlb47NGm1kDCS8w3BaelJ20wmSORAuQ4Nymp5nA0oVCnkNUNvL7k3ZB1TRz8ZfIA8GTNIof0GwImYiVge2sfnRUo2WC2YPNntMFdWKFI811T1JNkBF5SQSMa4w77BAoLjXg%3D%3D)**

What does that mean? Well, **it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday.** We had set aside $6,000 for this program, but in the end had to move that money to fund our TV ADS when we fell well short of finding enough money to pay for both initiatives.

clean_body: When I saw that only 10 donors made a gift to my campaign yesterday, my heart dropped. We don't have this race in the bag. We still need your help The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | Peter, Have I asked for too much? I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling. Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. Just 10 of you reading this contributed. When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out. According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just $12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans. While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. [[Help fund our field program]]() What does that mean? Well, it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday. We had set aside $6,000 for this program, but in the end had to move that money to fund our TV ADS when we fell well short of finding enough money to pay for both initiatives. | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | | | I hate to be rude and ask for more from the people who have made this campaign possible, however, if you’re able to make one additional gift, it really could make the difference. While we're unable to add any more money to our TV ADS, we can and still will use your contribution to win this race. name: Kristina Karamo
subject: A Republic, if You Can Keep It
body:
In just 4 days, Michiganders will decide if they want to take back our state from the authoritarians who are destroying it.

My opponent likes to claim that we are a threat to democracy. We are a Constitutional Republic, not a democracy! And it is she and her cronies who are the threat!

When Ben Franklin was asked, "What type of government have you created?", he famously responded: "A Republic, if you can keep it."

Can we keep it? The time is now. This is the moment he was speaking of. Will we rise up and hold on to our God-given rights, or will we watch as our country continues to race head-long into tyranny? Will our children inherit the great country that we grew up in, or will they wait in food lines, freeze in their homes, and scrape to make a living?

All of us were created for a time such as this. I urge you to vote out Jocelyn Benson. I urge you to vote NO on Proposal 2. I urge you to call your friends, family and neighbors and make sure they are all voting the same. Take them to the polls if you must!

Benson has been slapped down five times by judges for breaking the law. She continues to ignore the law. They will try to steal this election. WE MUST OVERWHELM THE SYSTEM with our votes!

I cannot overstate the absolute importance of removing this authoritarian regime from office!

Please VOTE for Tudor Dixon, Matt DePerno and me on November 8!

# Everyone Hates Matt Gaetz
---
| [DONATE](https://thepoliticalmatrix.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c3bea68b6a04118d41358241a&id=2b4511b138&e=10b14e738f "DONATE")

---
| Whether it’s the conspiratorial rantings about the 2020 election, the still-ongoing sex trafficking investigation, or his online bullying of teenagers, he’s the picture definition of deplorable.

But let us take a minute to brag on the woman running against him, because she’s more than just “ _the person running against Matt Gaetz.”_

Rebekah grew up the second of four children to teenage parents in rural, south Mississippi. She earned a full scholarship to Syracuse University, where she graduated _cum laude_ even after [having her son midway through college](https://thepoliticalmatrix.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c3bea68b6a04118d41358241a&id=43294b9f1e&e=10b14e738f). Rebekah then went on to earn her Master of Science degree from LSU in climate science, then moved to Florida in 2016 to begin her doctoral studies.

Along the way, she was elected thrice to the S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications student representative committee, was appointed by the Dean of her college at LSU to the Presidential Transition Advisory Committee (one of only two graduate students at the university appointed), and won some of the highest honors in her field.

Rebekah Jones is a published, award-winning, and internationally celebrated scientist whose research focuses on reconstructing historical hurricanes over the last 18,000 years. You can read her very long scientific and professional credentials in the resume below.

---
|
---
| Rebekah committed her education and career to studying climate change and its impacts on extreme weather after experiencing the destructive force of hurricanes first-hand in 2005 with Hurricane Katrina. Rebekah worked in public service as a scientist, researcher and disaster response manager for more than a decade before setting her sights on Congress.

At only 33 years old, she’s already won or been named:
**\+ Forbes 2021 _(and first ever_) Technology Person of the Year
\+ Fortune’s 40 Under 40 in Healthcare (2020)
\+ Whistleblower of the Year (2021)
\+ Elemental’s “50 Experts to Trust in a Pandemic” (2020)
\+ a John Maddox Prize nominee (2021), the _‘Nobel Prize in Science Advocacy’_**

**Bonus!**
The Daily Beast named her “[Ron DeSantis’ Worst Nightmare](https://thepoliticalmatrix.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c3bea68b6a04118d41358241a&id=1f7c65dc9f&e=10b14e738f)” and CNN one of their “Political Gamechangers to Watch.”

Rebekah took her celebrity and turned it into positive change, taking on Florida’s corrupt political landscape from the very bottom to the very top.

She’s outraised every Democratic congressional candidate in Florida in small donor contributions except her good friend Maxwell Frost, a fellow trailblazer and ally.

Despite all Ron DeSantis, Matt Gaetz and the Florida GOP have done to Rebekah and her family, she remains steady, strong and ready to serve in her pursuit of a more equitable, just America. Congress would be lucky to have her, and we’re lucky to be on her team.

THAT is why this conservative district has Matt Gaetz and Rebekah Jones tied so far in exit polling.

THAT is why you should help us cross the finish line by donating to Rebekah's campaign today.

Not just because you hate Matt Gaetz – _but because Rebekah Jones is someone worth fighting for._

| | | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001adC7MtCIMfdkpaWCmUVImK8r3XReuE-xqKCkCJ8DkO9JwHWaycOV8_o9WnfS-_sW_nnng9cXYB_7q7ZVe051_MwpfiuVw4pAqnoDN9Phb0UK4ECcYKIJ_ZasA7UyHutv1B9tNpRiLbOLLSZf-N4RFAt9vzxC0lWQjBFI6c1KpZfBRVW1v6xjZ7nHLdVOzJIdNxH4oR6czF0NeY4JUKUYFGBEuyiMZZ7H9bgcTwulLC0=&c=-P7t3RS3iJz522WpWZ80qYTf3r7SBp6BadCNVgxWeQFpm6FMbHbySA==&ch=RFcUU4VBCgWXsn90Bzwnr9v6iIWXOiFFYw7cRn718X_UUPzD8vd7YA==)

| Peter,
Nevadans are pretty tired of fake promises.
Yet that's exactly what we're getting from Steve Sisolak - while he gives us nothing but empty rhetoric, let's take a look at what has ACTUALLY unfolded under his watch...

* Nevada is the second least educated state in the country
* Payroll taxes were raised when we couldn't afford it, and 95,000 small businesses were closed for GOOD under his mandates
* Criminals and drug dealers were given lighter sentences as soft-on-crime policies made it harder for my team and I to even do our jobs
* And one of the worst corruption scandals in state history saw millions of dollars go to Sisolak's allies, while countless lives were put at risk

THAT is what's really behind all his fake promises.
So here's a promise you can ACTUALLY bank on...
When you help me FIRE this corrupt, soft-on-crime Governor JUST 4 DAYS FROM TODAY, I promise to immediately get to work expanding school choice, improving school safety, and repealing Steve Sisolak's soft-on-crime measures. I will also veto any new tax increase that makes its way to my desk, and I will bring back fiscally-responsible economic policies to the Governor's Office.
It's about time we had leadership we can trust - not just empty words.
If you agree, [will you help this campaign finish strong so we can win this race 4 days from now? >>](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001adC7MtCIMfdkpaWCmUVImK8r3XReuE-xqKCkCJ8DkO9JwHWaycOV8_o9WnfS-_sW_nnng9cXYB_7q7ZVe051_MwpfiuVw4pAqnoDN9Phb0UK4ECcYKIJ_ZasA7UyHutv1B9tNpRiLbOLLSZf-N4RFAt9vzxC0lWQjBFI6c1KpZfBRVW1v6xjZ7nHLdVOzJIdNxH4oR6czF0NeY4JUKUYFGBEuyiMZZ7H9bgcTwulLC0=&c=-P7t3RS3iJz522WpWZ80qYTf3r7SBp6BadCNVgxWeQFpm6FMbHbySA==&ch=RFcUU4VBCgWXsn90Bzwnr9v6iIWXOiFFYw7cRn718X_UUPzD8vd7YA==)

Peter,

Election Day is around the corner and my team and I have been working around the clock to get out the vote and reach undecided Washingtonians in every corner of the 8th District.

| | Tuesday is a big day for America...

_It's Judgment Day._

So please, show up to vote, and let's take our country back.

And if you're an Idahoan... let's also make sure to _take our state back_ from the establishment folks who would rather grow and serve the state over the people.

Part of that is [_**voting YES on SJR 102**_](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=d919a0a972&e=dea908e0fe).

This would take power AWAY from the Governor, and put it back into the hands of the legislature.

It's long overdue.

[You can read about it here](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=4a363f31da&e=dea908e0fe "what the heck is SJR 102?")

I'm sure you've seen all the voter guides, etc. so if you have any questions about anything, let me know.

Cheers,

Brian

| | Here we go again. Across the country, Republican leaders are talking again about **_cuts_** to Social Security and Medicare. Let me be absolutely clear about where I stand: I will fight to **_strengthen_** Social Security and Medicare, stand against privatizing Social Security or cutting benefits, demand lower prescription drug costs, and always advocate for nutrition assistance for seniors. **I am proud to be a sponsor of the Social Security 2100 Act** — a law that would increase benefits, improve protections against inflation, require millionaires and billionaires to pay the same tax rate as working-class folks, and protect Social Security for the future. The winner of this Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Pennsylvania. This is a consequential election for everyone living here, and so it’s critical I have your support in this tough race.

Derek — here in Pennsylvania, I’m running for Governor to take on the big fights and help Pennsylvanians get ahead. I’m determined to protect abortion rights, expand access to the ballot box, tackle rising costs, and create more economic opportunities. As your next Governor, I have a lot of ideas for how to do all that — how to help families not just get by, but get ahead. That’s why I’m humbly asking for your personal endorsement before Election Day, Derek. **[Will you become an official supporter of our campaign to protect our democracy and our freedoms here in Pennsylvania?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54044275/377291804/-146964294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGEyYTU3ZC03NzVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aJru5cto4B1V0Onfnwqj_UpFk3t2Or60DPqeMAV5jkc=&emci=8c9af16e-cc5a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=c0a2a57d-775c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=21962291)** | | [Add your name →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54044276/377291805/-146964294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGEyYTU3ZC03NzVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aJru5cto4B1V0Onfnwqj_UpFk3t2Or60DPqeMAV5jkc=&emci=8c9af16e-cc5a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=c0a2a57d-775c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=21962291)

The stakes of this race are so high, Derek.
* In our post-_Roe_ world, reproductive rights will be determined on a state-by-state basis, meaning the next Governor will decide if abortion remains safe, legal, and accessible here in Pennsylvania. My opponent says his “#1 issue” is passing an abortion ban with absolutely no exceptions — a bill I wouldn’t hesitate to veto.

* The very foundations of our democracy are at stake because the next Governor will appoint the official who runs our elections — and will get to decide how we vote in future elections.

* The ability to unionize is at risk. I will defend workers’ rights — my extreme opponent would work to destroy the union way of life.

* Rising costs have hit all of us — but especially those Pennsylvanians making the minimum wage, which sits at $7.25/hour. My opponent is against raising the minimum wage. I believe no one in Pennsylvania should be forced to live on poverty-level wages.

**Here’s the thing, Derek: the winner of this Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Pennsylvania. This is a consequential election for everyone living here, and so it’s critical I have your support in this tough race.**
**[If we’re going to win, it needs to be all-hands-on-deck for the next four days. Will you join me?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54044277/377291806/-146964294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGEyYTU3ZC03NzVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aJru5cto4B1V0Onfnwqj_UpFk3t2Or60DPqeMAV5jkc=&emci=8c9af16e-cc5a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=c0a2a57d-775c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=21962291)**
Thank you. Let’s win this thing.
Josh Shapiro

clean_body: The winner of this Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Pennsylvania. This is a consequential election for everyone living here, and so it’s critical I have your support in this tough race. Derek — here in Pennsylvania, I’m running for Governor to take on the big fights and help Pennsylvanians get ahead. I’m determined to protect abortion rights, expand access to the ballot box, tackle rising costs, and create more economic opportunities. As your next Governor, I have a lot of ideas for how to do all that — how to help families not just get by, but get ahead. That’s why I’m humbly asking for your personal endorsement before Election Day, Derek. | | The stakes of this race are so high, Derek. In our post-Roe world, reproductive rights will be determined on a state-by-state basis, meaning the next Governor will decide if abortion remains safe, legal, and accessible here in Pennsylvania. My opponent says his “#1 issue” is passing an abortion ban with absolutely no exceptions — a bill I wouldn’t hesitate to veto. The very foundations of our democracy are at stake because the next Governor will appoint the official who runs our elections — and will get to decide how we vote in future elections. The ability to unionize is at risk. I will defend workers’ rights — my extreme opponent would work to destroy the union way of life. Rising costs have hit all of us — but especially those Pennsylvanians making the minimum wage, which sits at $7.25/hour. My opponent is against raising the minimum wage. I believe no one in Pennsylvania should be forced to live on poverty-level wages. Here’s the thing, Derek: the winner of this Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Pennsylvania. This is a consequential election for everyone living here, and so it’s critical I have your support in this tough race. Thank you. Let’s win this thing. body:
Rural Michigan doctor’s bid for Congress bridges political divide
A fascinating Congressional race is taking shape in Northern Michigan. Dr. Bob Lorinser, running on the Democratic ticket, is uniting liberals, independents, and conservative voters with his “no B.S.” approach to politics.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/octad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/octad]
Dr. Bob Lorinser's professional background may be rooted in medicine, but his service to community and country fuels his political platform.
CAN I GET YOUR SUPPORT? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/octad]
GWINN, Mich. — This year, growing support for Dr. Bob Lorinser's Congressional bid appears to have the embattled incumbent, Rep. Jack Bergman, nervous. Constituents of all political backgrounds — Democrats, Republicans, Independents, and voters without party affiliation — are gravitating to Dr. Bob's habitual honesty and his 'no B.S.' approach to policy.
"It's been difficult for my opponent to define me," concedes Lorinser. "I understand. Our political system is so divided that there's a tendency to categorize candidates as 'one of us' or 'one of them,' with no in-between. Too many Washington politicians are aligning with the fringes of their parties. The consequence is; Nothing meaningful gets done.
"Where has statesmanship gone? I'm running on a platform to help bring cooperation, compromise, and collaboration back to Michigan's 1st District. Refusing to compromise is not strength, and it's not representational. A leader never ignores constituents even when they disagree because when a Congressman goes at it alone, they might as well be lost."
Lorinser's positions are a refreshing smorgasbord of solutions. Dr. Bob rejects labels entirely and scoffs when asked if he considers himself a progressive, a moderate, or a conservative.
"I'm not interested in those labels," he says. "I completely reject them. Completely. We need less focus on how we define a politician and more focus on how we define problems and solutions. My allegiance belongs to the hardworking people of this district before partisan ideology. Period."
So, where does he stand on the hot-button issues?
He has numerous positions on combating inflation and gas prices. Lorinser is a proponent of economic viability, thriving small businesses, and higher caliber jobs. He supports unions because he says they benefit the employer, the worker, and the consumer, a "win, win, win," he calls it.
Lorinser criticizes his opponent for increasing the deficit and wasting taxpayer money on unfunded tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy.
Dr. Bob is an 'advocate for life' and wants to reduce abortion, but he respects medical privacy, individual liberty, and body autonomy, making him also pro-choice. He says criminalizing abortion only makes it dangerous.
"If Washington DC's goal was to reduce abortion, they wouldn't overturn Roe v. Wade," contends Lorinser. "They would support affordable and accessible medical and childcare, promote postsecondary training and education, support the American family, and address childhood poverty and economic viability with good paying jobs and benefits."
Dr. Bob supports the 2nd Amendment, calling it part of the culture and lifestyle of fiercely independent 1st District people. While at the same time, the candidate offers concrete and robust solutions to reduce gun violence, which he calls a 'public health crisis.' He sides with 80% of Democrats and Republicans who support universal background checks.
"I'm most passionate about affordable and accessible healthcare," says Dr. Lorinser. "No one should suffer when we can save taxpayer money and cover every American."
Where Bergman has failing grades — one of the worst in Congress — Lorinser hopes to advance initiatives for wildlife conservation to preserve hunting and fishing rights for his constituency and tourists. He's a strong supporter of environmental and Great Lakes protection.
Lorinser supports veterans, law enforcement, educators, the LGBT community, and minorities. He is a proponent of organized labor, criminal justice system improvements, school safety, campaign finance reform, immigration reform, DACA, refugee programs, and border security.
"My positions don't necessarily reflect any particular party platform," said Lorinser. "These positions are what works best for us in the 1st District, Michigan, and the rest of the United States.
Lorinser's platform is refreshing and exciting across the board but frustrating for his opposition. Jack Bergman has comically tried to label Dr. Bob a "bureaucrat," a "Socialist," and a "radical leftist." Yet, so far, Bergman has ignored all attempts by media outlets to participate in a debate with his challenger.
"He can call me all the names he wants," says Lorinser. "The labels I accept - I'm a grandfather, a father, a husband, a friend, and a Yooper who is so concerned about the direction of our Nation that I'll work tirelessly every day to improve it."

# As a Veteran, I Stand with Veterans.
I swore an oath to defend our Constitution and I still honor that oath.
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=534cdbe81b&e=e60663a86e)
**Duty. Honor. Country.****This is a photo of me from 1968.** If you told me then, that in 2022 I would be running for US Congress to defend our American Democracy from extremist election-denying, insurrection-supporting Republicans, I never would’ve believed you. Yet here we are. I welcome everyone, Democrats, Independents, and fair-minded Republicans to join me in our collective fight to defend our democracy, restore women’s full rights over their own bodies, protect our voting rights, defend Social Security + Medicare, honor our Veterans, and eject divisive right-wing extremism from US Congress.I ask each of you to please talk to your family, friends, neighbors, co-workers and help them see what is at stake this election; our very Democracy that make us Americans. Thank you for your support and your vote.With Sincere Gratitude,
Mike Ford[**mike4georgia.com**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=222fe19783&e=e60663a86e)
|
---
**My Opponent, Rep Andrew Clyde Repeatedly Voted Against Veterans in US Congress****As a combat Vietnam War Veteran, I’m proud of my military service and I commit to uphold our nation's solemn oath to honor our military members, past, present, and future.** The myriad of tough issues that face our veterans, active-duty military, and military families are deeply personal for me and when I am in Congress you can count on me to advocate on behalf of our brave men and women who wore and wear the uniform to protect and defend our nation.From timely access to VA medical care, homeless veterans, high rates of suicide, untreated mental health issues, to struggling to reacclimate to society after multiple deployments, continuing education, find good job opportunities, being targeted by predatory lenders, our veterans and military families need our ongoing support. Our female Veterans face a number of unique and often overlooked issues related to their military experiences. I am committed to advocate on behalf of all veterans, active-duty military, and military families. You can count on me to have your back and vote to pass legislation to make your lives better.**Recent votes in both the US House and Senate proved yet again that far too many Republican politicians, including my opponent, give nothing but empty lip service when they say, "Thank you for your service." or "We support the troops".** It is shocking and infuriating that 174 Republicans in the US House voted AGAINST the Honoring our PACT Act which guarantees coverage for the long-term medical care desperately needed by Iraq and Afghanistan Veterans suffering devastating illnesses from their exposure to toxic burn pits.Only when comedian and Veteran’s activist, Jon Stewart, helped shine a spotlight on this outrageous Republican betrayal of our Veterans did enough Senate Republicans finally get publicly shamed into joining all the Democrats to pass the bill.Republicans in Congress betrayed our Veterans again this September when 49 Republicans, including my opponent, Andrew Clyde, voted against a simple, single-issue bill to help address food security for homeless and disabled Veterans. It is unconscionable that these Veterans bills are not passed in US Congress with unanimous support, but time and again, Republicans are the only ones voting “Nay”.Veterans, active-duty military, and their respective family members should not forget how elected Republicans continue to fail them and vote accordingly for Democrats this November 8th. **It’s time to vote out Republicans, not just in GA-09 but in every district.**
|
---
**Today is the last day to vote early!****Today, Friday Nov 4th is the last day to vote early!** Please don’t delay, vote early. **Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 8.** Democracy is not a spectator sport, as citizens of the United States of America, it is our civic duty to vote. To preview your full ballot of all candidates + ballot initiatives, simply go to [**www.ballotpedia.org**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=51ee780add&e=e60663a86e) click on “2022 Elections” then click on “Preview My Ballot” then enter your address. When voting, don’t stop at the top, vote blue the entire ballot.
**A Word of Thanks + Gratitude****I want to take a moment to say thank you to everyone who has donated to my campaign and who has supported my campaign in any manner.** To all the folks who have followed and liked me on social media, to those who have attended events, who mailed postcards, who put out yard signs, and more, thank you for all you have done. I’m truly appreciative of all your ongoing support! Let’s keep up the momentum and finish this race to the end. Less than a week to go and we are still fighting for every vote.

**Cliff Schecter**

name: Charles Booker
subject: I took a stand
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Kentucky, yesterday I took a stand for us -- for all of us.

Early voting has started -- and I proudly cast my ballot.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18832?t=1001&akid=2719%2E346206%2EYtYJ5L ][IMG]

I took a stand for the rights of women to make their own decisions.

I took a stand for our teachers to make sure they get the benefits they
deserve.

I took a stand for our veterans so they aren’t left out on the streets or
forced to suffer from devastating illnesses and injuries.

I took a stand for affordable housing, better infrastructure, clean air,
and clean water.

And I took a stand to protect our democracy.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18832?t=1002&akid=2719%2E346206%2EYtYJ5L ]Now, we need to get all Kentuckians out to the polls to do the same
thing. Will you pitch in $20 or more to help us get out the vote this
weekend?

TAKE A STAND →

We've got a big fundraising deadline coming up tomorrow night, so please chip in
what you can.

Thanks for your support,

Charles Booker

Mark Ronchetti

Peter-
Dan Crenshaw here.
This week, with Election Day just around the corner, I continued to call on voters to pay special attention to the critical down ballot races that have an enormous impact on the safety and prosperity of our local communities. I challenged Democrats who want to "declare a pandemic amnesty" and skip accountability for the destructive COVID lockdowns of our schools. And I made a pitch to undecided voters who are on the fence about supporting Republican candidates by reminding them what we stand for: security.
As always, thank you for your support. Now, here's your campaign brief:

| EVERY REPUBLICAN, EVERY RACE

| |
---
|
---
| |
---
| Harris County--my home--is a microcosm of the broader story of America over the past few years, where Democrat policies nationwide have created skyrocketing crime, corruption, and economic decline in our major cities. Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo is one the worst local leaders in the country. But her draconian COVID restrictions and budget tricks that defunded law enforcement are typical of the far-left leaders you'll find in almost every major city.
What's also typical is that these local officials will often appear very far down your ballot. In the case of Harris County, voters have over 80 races to select. This includes County Judge and dozens of judicial seats that will have a much greater and immediate impact on our lives than any statewide or federal race. It is not hyperbole to say that Lina Hidalgo and the Democrat criminal court judges who swept into office in 2018 are a danger to Harris County. Just look at these statistics:
---

|
---
|
---
| No matter where you live, it is absolutely critical that you vote for every Republican in every race. Five minutes of your time will make the difference for thousands of crime victims.

| There's an article floating around online from The Atlantic that has a pretty insulting message: forgive and forget those who pushed COVID lockdowns on our schools and communities.
The author says that we have to "learn from our mistakes and let go," and stop "dwelling on the mistakes of history."
The issue here is Democrats who insisted on shutting down America's schools can't even admit it was a mistake. They're trying to rewrite history and instead, take credit for the inevitable re-opening of the schools--something they did everything in their power to stop. The people who forced our kids into online learning haven't even asked for forgiveness--and instead are pretending they played no role in our kids' declining math and reading skills and increased mental health issues. We have to make sure this will never happen again, and that starts with accountability.

| WHAT DO WE STAND FOR?

These communities do not normally get touched in GOTV efforts from other organizations and groups, or even political parties and campaigns – we are filling this gap as it is part of who we are as an organization. 2. Peter,

**Have I asked for too much?** I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, **with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling.**

Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. **Just 10 of you reading this contributed.** When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out.

**According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just 12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans.**

While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. **[[Help fund our field program]](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3bae3f71a8e84da89e04dde37c36bf56&_e=ZPrYIKUiG8ttcjKJ4AC0eQpp5MdXnfPQor8rbXB-xkkyot5ok-AlfNcg6LtebJmQPqtLiz2xpZYT8FunK4IkbRpP2g-qaS4-Hb92veJkQ-HDluu6kVRKFbDB3voanYoxRE1TXZzCl5nrX-4BpLRnddcpL2zltkkv4Uo-e1wiKhMP8AxrvBX3q-l6FKtJp0XFwPsNkz-vH5nQvDtbMZgjsjyBeTlyBOVjCBz5KcI7Qdh1GPNE7UUxOOi7O6frWS3q89kHUEY72pOI2xlA-HVAJio_8m_MsRTUKzgo-tIlDPEqygz7Jhpof4_EMrOaOXDn3I9-kLht2s0NbJFnnsK3T-mtvcPNJJG1Zt3vUglT7gA9E6PEoZpbgGFy1E6STAsd9rlEW91CbYd5bktcmVyX0Q%3D%3D)**

Well, it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday. We had set aside $6,000 for this program, but in the end had to move that money to fund our TV ADS when we fell well short of finding enough money to pay for both initiatives. | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | | | I hate to be rude and ask for more from the people who have made this campaign possible, however, if you’re able to make one additional gift, it really could make the difference. [[Help fund our field program]]() It's not too late for us to put your donation to good use. While we're unable to add any more money to our TV ADS, we can and still will use your contribution to win this race. | | **November 4, 2022**
---
| | **Delegate Greenhalgh Tours the Virginia Beach Housing Resource Center**
---
| |
---
| | Last week, Delegate Greenhalgh and Virginia Beach School Board member Jennifer Franklin were led on a tour of the Virginia Beach Housing Resource Center by Resource Development Coordinator, Erin Walker. The Housing Resource Center (HRC) provides numerous resources and services to members of our community who are experiencing homelessness or a housing crisis. The facility has a 124 bed capacity in its shelter and housing units, offers day services such as showers and laundry to unsheltered individuals, and has a health clinic and dining hall on site. Delegate Greenhalgh is proud of all the work being done at the HRC to address homelessness in Virginia Beach!
---
| | |
---
| | **Pack the Box Community Donation Drive to Benefit the Virginia Beach Housing Resource Center**
---
| |
---
| | Join VB Home Now for their annual Community Donation Drive on Saturday, Nov. 19, from 10 a.m. – 12 p.m., at the Housing Resource Center. Help fill the HRC shipping containers with items needed to resource our neighbors in need throughout the colder months ahead. A list of needed items can be found at [www.vbhomenow.org](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/e70857081ce80186/0e3352a2f300b286c3d6b838967d376c/37923). If you would like to make an impact but cannot attend the event, please consider making a donation online using the link above.
---
|
---
| | **Virginia Healthcare Foundation Cheers for Champions Awards**
---
| |
---
| | As a member of the Joint Commission on Health Care, Delegate Greenhalgh was honored to attend Cheers for Champions! The event recognized mental health professionals throughout the state who were nominated by their peers for their outstanding service to their communities. Governor Youngkin and Secretary Littel praised some of Virginia's finest before they received their awards. Delegate Greenhalgh is grateful for the hard work of all the mental health professionals in Virginia who have dedicated themselves to serve the needs of others!
---
| | |
---
**Tour of STIHL Inc. in Virginia Beach**
---
| |
---
|
---
| | Delegate Greenhalgh was thrilled to be offered a tour of STIHL's Virginia Beach manufacturing facility this week. The company did not fail to impress as it showcased its extensive in house manufacturing and assembly capabilities along with all of the benefits it offers to its dedicated employees. We were glad to see so much of STIHL's signature orange while on the company's campus, Delegate Greenhalgh's orange car blended right in!

Fellow American,

When I think back on the last two tumultuous years under Democrat leadership, I remember how:

Our cities burned.

Our families were scared, even in their own homes.

Violent crime surged across our communities.

**_When our country needed real leadership, we were failed._**

So, when my second child was born and I looked into his big curious eyes, I knew I had to run for Congress because our families deserve so much better than a state ran by radical liberals who want to defund our police, open our borders, and destroy the foundation our country was built on.

[**If we haven’t met yet, I’m Tyler Kistner.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=24cce4920200446ab18b7e4fdbc40f1e&_e=KVSrf3p2hbIAqOfOD4I2FNgQLNXfJPs79sEL8-FdxZ6feZFinHFXdJeZ2KgqoJioYb2EOw-2r3e_3PVPgdBSnt5YuV2kPBnCsXws1DXM-41URF9EuF95vbgXWtVBhfXTqrpKXTJolhFpMxMYxhV7D0JRMv1EZHlz7zJtShQ6qZ-pA298GZcIspO7-D-6yoPXL2dpkShmctjSMeixmtjs_9s_tvc3BhBXIcNYa5-_ME6LnbNNMIbfvtvqVYUX9EFwUoMxDn5htm20BeVqqfUUeOykz_z4jTsKHU3YFYPt3pBRrWnb-RG-91xQr4ynSLF19bz7EzgJxbRxRjVhNvX3oqkhvhBz5NN8DJE9NAdPPEg-YzznFU1B4StoXYuUSQuVXLPlJGa5-CAHW9KWPmh3zg%3D%3D) **A proud father of two, husband, and Marine Raider Veteran. I would do anything for my children, my family, and my country.**

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=24cce4920200446ab18b7e4fdbc40f1e&_e=KVSrf3p2hbIAqOfOD4I2FNgQLNXfJPs79sEL8-FdxZ6feZFinHFXdJeZ2KgqoJioYb2EOw-2r3e_3PVPgdBSnt5YuV2kPBnCsXws1DXM-41URF9EuF95vbgXWtVBhfXTqrpKXTJolhFpMxMYxhV7D0JRMv1EZHlz7zJtShQ6qZ-pA298GZcIspO7-D-6yoPXL2dpkShmctjSMeixmtjs_9s_tvc3BhBXIcNYa5-_ME6LnbNNMIbfvtvqVYUX9EFwChMiMKutWyoAbHIMfDWQh-qvLfBCwKVCsWygX0qUN00RaNqtEcT-M9JMZGxnnataBymyuMDuszIF_MNQuEPjc7EVTTUM0aVwGrqpab-UHMQRJgSSkb6bQJN3bYidUVkq2A0ECnLAfBCrYC8sO-1bNg%3D%3D)

But right now, our nation is experiencing the early stages of tyranny. **We are facing an oppressive government who wants to strip us of our rights, ruin our economy, and rob our children of their future - _their birthrights as Americans._**

[** ****Send in the Marine ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=24cce4920200446ab18b7e4fdbc40f1e&_e=KVSrf3p2hbIAqOfOD4I2FNgQLNXfJPs79sEL8-FdxZ6feZFinHFXdJeZ2KgqoJioYb2EOw-2r3e_3PVPgdBSnt5YuV2kPBnCsXws1DXM-41URF9EuF95vbgXWtVBhfXTqrpKXTJolhFpMxMYxhV7D0JRMv1EZHlz7zJtShQ6qZ-pA298GZcIspO7-D-6yoPXL2dpkShmctjSMeixmtjs_9s_tvc3BhBXIcNYa5-_ME6LnbNNMIbfvtvqVYUX9EFwzW1O2YuYtmvynOZc3peRypwSPZ6oGqCiRJF5ZRFJFoW6kdpD5sGfBySpX-C0W0ZWyOanPm2_RHzZOMkPaq-R9LsSZscJpz-zuiDbffHCdLnUmxZFbwE0lDWpofPC7teVMcAlpHmw10uNN49LnvU1hQ%3D%3D)

My children deserve a shot at the America dream, and so do yours. _But the path we are on right now, is horrifying._

I served nine years in the U.S. Marine Corps, for five of those years I served in the elite Marine Special Operation Forces - the Marine Raiders. I took an oath to defend our Constitution, and my oath to this country will never expire.

[**I want to fix the broken system in Washington, so we have a country we are proud to leave for our next generation and that’s what I plan to do in Congress.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=24cce4920200446ab18b7e4fdbc40f1e&_e=KVSrf3p2hbIAqOfOD4I2FNgQLNXfJPs79sEL8-FdxZ6feZFinHFXdJeZ2KgqoJioYb2EOw-2r3e_3PVPgdBSnt5YuV2kPBnCsXws1DXM-41URF9EuF95vbgXWtVBhfXTqrpKXTJolhFpMxMYxhV7D0JRMv1EZHlz7zJtShQ6qZ-pA298GZcIspO7-D-6yoPXL2dpkShmctjSMeixmtjs_9s_tvc3BhBXIcNYa5-_ME6LnbNNMIbfvtvqVYUX9EFwUVQF5JqTSq5LZHjEtW1EMOs19cpohLs6JRRvPgsB-vTNsIIWNuN44zMHMcyw2h9Pths5HdwlzRTVlPCq17q2qDO01LGUKlViGyyGp_B3mHL8s1yeiB8Ef4CWVySLOx5DP4yanrdv1dPcTWOObWzigA%3D%3D)

[** ****HELP TYLER SAVE AMERICA ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=24cce4920200446ab18b7e4fdbc40f1e&_e=KVSrf3p2hbIAqOfOD4I2FNgQLNXfJPs79sEL8-FdxZ6feZFinHFXdJeZ2KgqoJioYb2EOw-2r3e_3PVPgdBSnt5YuV2kPBnCsXws1DXM-41URF9EuF95vbgXWtVBhfXTqrpKXTJolhFpMxMYxhV7D0JRMv1EZHlz7zJtShQ6qZ-pA298GZcIspO7-D-6yoPXL2dpkShmctjSMeixmtjs_9s_tvc3BhBXIcNYa5-_ME6LnbNNMIbfvtvqVYUX9EFweIbbDeeX7OQqEH1QhC4YH_ZJ9Vri0zqsTJLmLgT3sOAuSAZGrCwRBDe7GK84Zb5udKWP0EwubuCJ89424g7YmZF5Goq7W3T6eawwy1g2KU-NvML8-kASJAa6cUArkYJinPPjB7HQWV7_EBFAFzrL2A%3D%3D)

It’s one of the top seven races in the country because Republicans only need to net FIVE seats to regain our majority and _take the country back from the intolerant and radical Left._

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| | GWINN, Mich. — This year, growing support for Dr. Bob Lorinser's Congressional bid appears to have the embattled incumbent, Rep. Jack Bergman, nervous. Constituents of all political backgrounds — Democrats, Republicans, Independents, and voters without party affiliation — are gravitating to Dr. Bob's habitual honesty and his 'no B.S.' approach to policy.
"It's been difficult for my opponent to define me," concedes Lorinser. "I understand. Our political system is so divided that there's a tendency to categorize candidates as 'one of us' or 'one of them,' with no in-between. Too many Washington politicians are aligning with the fringes of their parties. The consequence is; Nothing meaningful gets done.
"Where has statesmanship gone? I'm running on a platform to help bring cooperation, compromise, and collaboration back to Michigan's 1st District. Refusing to compromise is not strength, and it's not representational. A leader never ignores constituents even when they disagree because when a Congressman goes at it alone, they might as well be lost."
Lorinser's positions are a refreshing smorgasbord of solutions. Dr. Bob rejects labels entirely and scoffs when asked if he considers himself a progressive, a moderate, or a conservative.
"I'm not interested in those labels," he says. "I completely reject them. Completely. We need less focus on how we define a politician and more focus on how we define problems and solutions. My allegiance belongs to the hardworking people of this district before partisan ideology. Period."

| | So, where does he stand on the hot-button issues? He has numerous positions on combating inflation and gas prices. Lorinser is a proponent of economic viability, thriving small businesses, and higher caliber jobs. He supports unions because he says they benefit the employer, the worker, and the consumer, a "win, win, win," he calls it.
Lorinser criticizes his opponent for increasing the deficit and wasting taxpayer money on unfunded tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy.
Dr. Bob is an 'advocate for life' and wants to reduce abortion, but he respects medical privacy, individual liberty, and body autonomy, making him also pro-choice. He says criminalizing abortion only makes it dangerous.
"If Washington DC's goal was to reduce abortion, they wouldn't overturn Roe v. Wade," contends Lorinser. "They would support affordable and accessible medical and childcare, promote postsecondary training and education, support the American family, and address childhood poverty and economic viability with good paying jobs and benefits."
Dr. Bob supports the 2nd Amendment, calling it part of the culture and lifestyle of fiercely independent 1st District people. While at the same time, the candidate offers concrete and robust solutions to reduce gun violence, which he calls a 'public health crisis.' He sides with 80% of Democrats and Republicans who support universal background checks. "I'm most passionate about affordable and accessible healthcare," says Dr. Lorinser. "No one should suffer when we can save taxpayer money and cover every American."
Where Bergman has failing grades — one of the worst in Congress — Lorinser hopes to advance initiatives for wildlife conservation to preserve hunting and fishing rights for his constituency and tourists. He's a strong supporter of environmental and Great Lakes protection.
Lorinser supports veterans, law enforcement, educators, the LGBT community, and minorities. He is a proponent of organized labor, criminal justice system improvements, school safety, campaign finance reform, immigration reform, DACA, refugee programs, and border security. "My positions don't necessarily reflect any particular party platform," said Lorinser. "These positions are what works best for us in the 1st District, Michigan, and the rest of the United States. Lorinser's platform is refreshing and exciting across the board but frustrating for his opposition. Jack Bergman has comically tried to label Dr. Bob a "bureaucrat," a "Socialist," and a "radical leftist." Yet, so far, Bergman has ignored all attempts by media outlets to participate in a debate with his challenger. "He can call me all the names he wants," says Lorinser. "The labels I accept - I'm a grandfather, a father, a husband, a friend, and a Yooper who is so concerned about the direction of our Nation that I'll work tirelessly every day to improve it."

body:
I’m reaching out because this fundraising deadline is critical for our work.
#
Peter,
As you know, on Tuesday we set a 48-hour deadline for our campaign to raise the rest of the funds necessary to hit our fundraising goal of $75,000. **Now we’re just hours away from our deadline of 5pm.**
The clock is running out and we need support from folks like you to get us all the way to $75,000. So I ran the numbers to check exactly how far away we are from our goal as of right now:
**Progress to Fundraising Goal** | **Amount**
---|---
Target: | $75,000
Raised: | $72,198
**Difference:** | **–$2,802**
**Donations Needed:** | **118**
[**_Suggested Donation:_**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22445?refcode=em20221104-1805&t=1&akid=1805%2E420207%2EFarNDa) | [**$24.54**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22445?refcode=em20221104-1805&t=2&akid=1805%2E420207%2EFarNDa)
**[Contribute $24.54](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22445?refcode=em20221104-1805&t=3&akid=1805%2E420207%2EFarNDa)**
[**Peter, I don’t reach out very often, but this is important. Reaching this goal is critical for our operations and we’re running out of time. Can you help us out?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22445?refcode=em20221104-1805&t=4&akid=1805%2E420207%2EFarNDa)
We’ve closed the gap significantly since we launched our goal and we’re very close now. **_Our average donation at the moment is only $24.54, so we only need 118 more donations to reach our goal._**
All of the progress we’ve made toward our goal since we launched on Wednesday is because of supporters like you. As always, it’s our grassroots base that powers Pramila’s work and ensures her success while she fights for us in Congress.
But it’s still true that **we haven’t hit our goal yet** , and unless we can mobilize our supporters to send an influx of last-minute donations, we won’t. [**If you have $24.54 to spare, we’d really appreciate your support by 5pm today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22445?refcode=em20221104-1805&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=1805%2E420207%2EFarNDa)
From the Congresswoman and our whole team, thank you.
Lauren Lalonde
Campaign Manager, Pramila for Congress

| | | Dear Peter,

Election Day is almost here! We need volunteers willing to join our [**Election Day Phone Banking Team**](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=1db444542a&e=c238e8971e). This is a great way to help us spread the word to voters, reminding them to go to the polls and VOTE JOHN GIBBS!

Team Gibbs will be making calls at Gibbs HQ in the morning starting 9AM until the polls close at 8PM. We ask that you bring a Smartphone/Laptop in order to make calls.

**Please sign up for one of the following phone banking shifts:**
* 9:00AM - 12:00PM
* 12:00PM - 3:00PM
* 3:00PM - 6:00PM
* 6:00PM - 8:00PM

** Location:** Gibbs HQ, 5651 Byron Center Ave SW, Wyoming, MI 49519, USA

**[Click here](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=d72d9d6941&e=c238e8971e)** or respond to this email to sign up for a shift.

God bless,

Team Gibbs

name: Peter Welch
subject: A few moments of reflection
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Recently, I was taking a look at an old photograph — and I noticed something.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1186%2E61531%2Ej0xWm8)
Let me tell you about an old jacket.
Recently, I was reflecting on our journey to get to this moment — so I took a few moments to take a look at this old photograph — and I noticed something.
It was a picture of friends and family on a hike decades ago at Mount Rainier. It was fun and peaceful — but also grueling — with the scorching sun and steep trails.
But in this picture, I noticed I was wearing the same blue windbreaker that I had on while looking at the photo.
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4850?t=3&akid=1186%2E61531%2Ej0xWm8)
This jacket has been with me through many good times. And certain things stay with me, just like this jacket. My time as an organizer protesting racial housing discrimination in Chicago. My early career as a public defender in White River Junction. Memories of my dad, our town’s dentist who would throw out bills for those who were struggling. I carry all of that with me — along with this jacket.
This jacket has been with me forever. And everytime I wear it — whether to hike, take a walk, or more recently, to campaign for the U.S. Senate in Vermont — I know I’m headed on an adventure when I pull it out of my closet.
And this campaign has certainly been an adventure — one I’ve been proud to be on alongside all of you — but it’s hard to ignore how the world and our environment is changing. We’re all facing some tough challenges — high cost of living, climate change, threats to our democracy — but I know one thing for sure: I’m ready to fight alongside you to tackle them in the U.S. Senate. I’m ready because of all the memories and experiences I’ll bring with me (and of course, I’ll be wearing my favorite jacket).
[**We’re just four days away from Election Day. Tackling these issues is going to take all of us working together. So please, if you’re able, will you contribute $3 or more to send me to the Senate to go get the job done?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4850?t=4&akid=1186%2E61531%2Ej0xWm8)
[CONTRIBUTE ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4850?t=7&t=8&akid=1186%2E61531%2Ej0xWm8)
---
Thanks so much,
Peter

Team,
It’s time for the craziest part of any campaign cycle: the final four.
These next four days will be complete insanity and Elissa sent an email earlier breaking down our strategy. You can read it below.
We wanted to make sure you saw her note and to reiterate just how critical the next four days will be. It’s not an exaggeration to say that elections are won and lost in this period. We’re doing everything we possibly can to deliver a favorable outcome on November 8th, but that does require a significant amount of resources. We have 8 staging locations throughout the district that will act as home bases for our volunteers and staff, and we need to ensure everything runs smoothly.
In such a tight race, letting up for even a moment can mean a loss of votes on Election Day. So, we’re asking if you’ll chip in to help us execute our final four plan and deliver a win on November 8th! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_2&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_2&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
The time has finally arrived.
We’re entering the period known as the “final four.” It’s pretty self explanatory -- it means the last four days before the election. It’s also known as “GOTV,” or Get Out The Vote.
That means Team Slotkin is about to have a *constant* presence around the new 7th. We’ll have 8 locations in the 2,813 square miles of the district that will serve as home bases for our organizers and volunteers as they make our final push to knock on thousands of doors and make even more phone calls.
The name of the game is turnout. We’re looking to get in touch with voters who haven't cast a ballot yet, making sure they have a plan to get to the polls and resolve any questions or issues they might have -- or, let them know how to drop off their absentee ballots. (One fifth of registered voters in this district have already voted via absentee ballot!)
We’re not taking our foot off the gas for even a moment – and that means having the resources we need to make it happen. The money we raise in these four days goes directly out the door into the voter contact efforts I just mentioned almost instantly. It goes right into the tangible things that our volunteers might need - all 663 of the folks doing a volunteer shift with us over the last four days.
In honor of our final four, I’m asking if you will contribute $4, $40, or even $140 to help us finish out strong. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_2&amount=28] Elections are won and lost in these final four days, and in one of the most competitive races in the country, we’re not leaving anything to chance.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221104_2&amount=28]
Elissa

Peter, My name is Jane Fonda, you may know me from my acting career, but I’ve been ruffling feathers in Washington for decades. **I am writing to you today for a very specific reason: to protect our planet from deadly fossil fuel pollution by volunteering for Tina Kotek this weekend.** Here’s what it comes down to. Too many politicians ignore the science on climate and the realities of what's at stake, including Tina’s opponents, Christine Drazan and Betsy Johnson. **When Christine Drazan was a state legislator, she literally walked off the job to kill bills to combat the climate crisis and keep Oregonians safe from wildfires.** Time is running out to avoid the worst-case scenario of the climate catastrophe. The stranglehold that oil, gas, and coal companies have on our political system is keeping us from passing laws that will save the planet... and us. But there is still hope, which is why I started the Jane Fonda Climate PAC to support candidates like Tina who will stand up to the fossil fuel industry. **There’s too much at risk this year if we don’t fight to make sure Tina Kotek wins the Governor’s race in Oregon.** [**Peter, I’m personally asking: Will you sign up to make phone calls this weekend to help protect our planet and elect Tina Kotek?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54062040/377322236/1434877450?utm_source=tk_email&refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20221103_PM2_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzEwMDEyZC04YTVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dNJ8jbz6waanZ9jKqXPxtckos-MI3ywF8gYYl0CZABs=&emci=657fdb26-8a5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=9c10012d-8a5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=15353729) | [SIGN UP NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54062048/377322237/1434877450?utm_source=tk_email&refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20221103_PM2_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzEwMDEyZC04YTVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dNJ8jbz6waanZ9jKqXPxtckos-MI3ywF8gYYl0CZABs=&emci=657fdb26-8a5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=9c10012d-8a5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=15353729)

name: Michael Peroutka
subject: Michael Peroutka Statement Regarding Bias Media
body:
It is regrettable that Mr. Shalleck would make such a false and misleading claim against me and my campaign.
|
---
MORE FAKE NEWS FROM BIASED MEDIA I have become aware of a story published at wtop.com (and reprinted in Maryland Matters on November 3rd) claiming that my campaign has received a warning from the Attorney General of Maryland regarding a statement recently published on my campaign facebook page. Apparently, Jim Shalleck, the gentleman who I defeated in the primary election, has accused me of being “disruptive” and of attempting to “cause havoc” with the election process. This is not true. I have not attempted in any way to “cause havoc” and neither I nor my campaign have received any such communication from the Attorney General. It is regrettable that Mr. Shalleck would make such a false and misleading claim against me and my campaign. As an attorney, Mr. Shalleck should know the law regarding defamation – and its consequences. It is also a shame that WTOP would publish this false narrative. This experience underscores why I generally do not give interviews to biased and unreliable “news sources” such as WTOP or Maryland Matters. Experience has reinforced for me the wisdom of Rudyard Kipling from his poem “IF”: _“...If you can bear to hear the truth you’ve spoken twisted by knaves to make a trap for fools...”_ -Michael Anthony Peroutka Republican Attorney General Candidate, MD _*By authority of Patriots for Michael Anthony Peroutka. Louis P. Reeder, Treasurer._

body:

Between now and Election Day, I will be meeting voters in the Portland area, making a final pitch for an independent governor, loyal only to Oregonians. Wherever I go, people are hungry for a change in our leadership and politics. When I began this campaign, I knew taking on the two-party machine would be tough. I didn’t care. I refused to give up on the state I love without one hell of a fight. Already, we’ve made a difference – setting the agenda with no nonsense and straight-talk:
* Ending tent cities...putting cops and victims before criminals...and picking up the damn trash.

* Working harder at graduating kids from high school...than legalizing dangerous drugs.

* Making Oregon affordable once again for working families...the backbone of our state.

* Respecting jobs and job creators...whether you make wood chips, cow chips, computer chips, potato chips, or fish and chips.

I could not have come this far without you – and thousands more like you. You have been the wind – and the money – beneath my wings. name: Val Demings
subject: I just made a tough call, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
| | |
---
Friend, it's Val Demings, and I just made a really tough call.
I just got out of an emergency meeting with my team, and they told me this: Marco Rubio has spent **$15.7 million** on TV ads this year, and a recent poll shows me just **1 point behind.** The bottom line is that I need to counter GOP spending with ads of my own – _immediately_.
I talked through our options with my team, and I ended up making a really difficult decision: **I approved a new ad buy to reach undecided voters over the next 4 days – even though we don't have the budget yet.**
I had no other choice here, friend. Races in Florida are always decided by razor-thin margins, so running just one more round of ads could help me reach just enough voters to win. I can't afford to play it safe – not when Senate control is on the line and our race is this tight.
**I know it's not ideal to spend the money before we raise it, but I have faith in this grassroots team. I took a gamble that we could raise $100,000 before midnight to cover the cost of our new ads – _and now, I'm counting on your support._**

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Down to the wire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Team:
It's always good to have a solid wingman on your six. So when President Obama came to Phoenix to help us turn out some voters this week, I was happy to see him.
He knows a thing or two about tough elections, and he came because he sees the same data we do. The same polls, the same turnout numbers.
**He came because he knows this is going to come down to the wire.** It's extremely likely that this race will be the closest in the country. But if we can get the people we need to vote early or on Election Day, we can do it. We can win.
And to reach all those people, we've got to fully fund our turnout program. We're spending down to zero almost every day now, but we're doing it because we know folks like you will help us get where we need to be the next day. So far, that's been true. >
Together, we can send Katie Porter back to Congress — and we can bring Summer Lee and Jamie McLeod-Skinner’s voices to Washington.
Watching **Katie Porter** ’s career unfold has been one of my greatest joys — ever since the first time she walked into my early-morning bankruptcy class, bright-eyed and ready to go. She’s been a fierce consumer advocate for decades. After the 2008 housing crisis, she held big banks’ feet to the fire to make sure they paid California families the money they were owed. And as a member of Congress, she’s held CEOs accountable, fought to lower the cost of child care, and taken on corporate price gouging.
But after the latest round of redistricting, with her district split down the middle between Democrats and Republicans, Katie’s in her toughest campaign yet. And expert forecasters just moved this race into the “toss-up” category. We’ve got to make sure she pulls through. We’ve got to keep her in Congress.
**Summer Lee** is a proven champion for racial, economic, and environmental justice for all Pennsylvanians — from advocating for better pay and safer working conditions to defeating dangerous corporate fracking proposals. She’s been a terrific state representative, and she’d make us proud as a congresswoman.
But the same Super PAC that tried to defeat Summer in her primary is now dumping truckloads of cash against her at the last minute. A recent poll had her up by just a few points, with 16 percent undecided — so if Summer can’t fight back against these new attacks, they could send her to defeat.
And here’s a weird coincidence: her Republican opponent has the same name as the retiring Democratic congressman in that district. It’s already tripped up some voters who meant to vote Democratic. So Summer’s team has to work even harder to make sure people know that she is the Democratic nominee.
Over in Oregon, **Jamie McLeod-Skinner** has built a strong campaign from the grassroots level — I saw it firsthand when I went to her district and spoke with a bunch of volunteers getting ready to go knock on doors. Jamie’s a small business owner, experienced public servant, and emergency response coordinator who’s running hard against corporate special interests like Big Pharma.
But we’ve got to help her fight back against all the outside spending pouring in against her — because our side is getting beaten on the airwaves. This could be one of the tightest congressional races in the country, and it could decide who controls the U.S. House. Every dollar we send Jamie’s way can help get her message out to more voters by Election Day.
**We still have the power to make a difference in the outcome of these races — and that gives me hope.**
[_**Please split a $3 contribution between Katie Porter, Summer Lee, Jamie McLeod-Skinner, and Warren Democrats today to help defend our House majority and elect champions for working people across the country.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54068840/377329995/682409729?refcode=EMZ10C_TAN_E_20221104_V1S1_NOR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTY0NDU1ZC04ZjVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Gw7QQuUeWq2m0RUkCOK6Uos_M9UVuRzDa5ZDYpXtVk=)
I’m deeply grateful for everything you’ve already done leading up to these midterm elections. Just a few days left. Let’s give this fight everything we’ve got.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

body:
Friends —

I wanted to share with you a headline from the tossup Senate race between
Democrat Tim Ryan and Republican JD Vance in Ohio that really set me off:

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/30714?t=1009&amount=32&akid=6400%2E3611125%2EE5aCYE ][IMG]

I don’t usually write emails like this, but it really got to me.

Listen Destiny, we can win the Senate race in Ohio. But often the
prognosticators and political handicappers in DC are slow to catch on.

And in this case, it means that the party isn’t buying TV and radio ads,
doing digital work and sending snail mail like it is in other races. And
Tim is left to win by himself.

That’s a real shame. Because Tim is exactly the type of Democrat we need
to win—and can win—in Ohio. He’s a college football star (no seriously
look it up), he speaks about the real needs of the working class, and is
the biggest “Make It in America” cheerleader I know.

Tim also knows how to call out the absolute BS of Republicans better than
any other candidate I know. As Tim so eloquently put it, Ohio doesn’t need
an ass-kisser. (His words, not mine!)

Now, imagine Tim in the Senate. Yeah, that's what I'm thinking, too.

The final few days are going to be make-or-break for Tim Ryan, and our
chances at holding onto the Senate. And to be honest, Tim could really use
your help to win. Even if some national Democrats aren’t paying attention
to his race.
