name: Macky Stafford
subject: Last minute reminders and volunteer opportunities
body:
Down to the wire! Thanks so much for making every last minute effort that you can.

Dear Patriots for Peroutka,

Down to the wire! Last minute volunteer opportunities and tips for voting on Tuesday. Please remember: No touch screens, paper only. Thanks so much for making every last minute effort that you can. Poll Watching should be like Jury Duty: You just gotta do it, view it as a privilege of living in a free country.

POLL WATCHING INFORMATION:

Please email CitizenVoter22@gmail.com (mailto:CitizenVoter22@gmail.com) for all you need to know ( and more!) to be a poll watcher. Remember, you can be a poll watcher (aka poll challenger) anywhere you want, for as little or as long as you want. We just really need people to step up and get involved! Less than 50 volunteers to cover 100’s and 100’s of polling locations throughout Maryland. It would make a whole lot of sense if every single person on this email came early or stayed late to poll watch for a little while...thanks!

STAY VIGILANT ON TUESDAY:

If you see or hear anything suspicious at all, please err on the side of caution and report it:

Election Operators Hotline; 410-210-4450. Plug this in to your contacts now!

Email is: Help@MD.ProtectTheVote.com (mailto:Help@MD.ProtectTheVote.com)

VOTER INTEGRITY TIPS:

If you have voting in your state on Tuesday, please do the following with your phones or computers:

- From your car (or parking lot), check your devices for available Wi-Fi networks and record these names.
- While waiting in line to vote, check for available Wi-Fi networks again and see if there are any new ones. Record new names, if any.
- In the privacy booth, check for available Wi-Fi.
- If you find any new Wi-Fi networks that do not belong, please email your County and State Board of Elections with the name of the Wi-Fi network. Ask them to Investigate.
- In Maryland, alsoreport to the Voter Integrity Hotline: 410-210-4450.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Our movement is at a turning point. On Tuesday, the entire Squad is up for
re-election and we have a chance to expand our progressive bloc by
electing Summer Lee, Greg Casar, and Odessa Kelly.

We’re having a BIG impact on transforming the Democratic Party by fighting
to elect leaders like Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, and the Squad.
Right-wing super PACs spend millions of dollars against us and our
candidates because they’re afraid of our collective progressive power.

We’re in a fight for the soul of the Democratic Party and are working to
transform it from the inside out, but we’ve always faced many obstacles
because we’re going up against the political establishment. As a scrappy
organization, our overhead is much lower than other political
organizations.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/120084?refcode=em20221104-25900&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=25900%2E1203867%2EZH4X5q ]With just four days until Election Day, please make a contribution to
help us stay in this work. Your support will help us re-elect the Squad
and grow our collective power in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/120084?refcode=em20221104-25900&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=25900%2E1203867%2EZH4X5q ]Contribute $3

Thank you so much for everything that you’re doing to support our
movement. >From the very beginning, our work has been rooted in
working-class power, so grassroots support is crucial to our work.

More soon,

Alexandra Rojas

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1021&akid=25900%2E1203867%2EZH4X5q ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1022&akid=25900%2E1203867%2EZH4X5q ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20221104-25900-footer&t=1023&refcode2=25900_1203867_ZH4X5q&akid=25900%2E1203867%2EZH4X5q

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1024&akid=25900%2E1203867%2EZH4X5q

subject: Washington Has Been Weaponized
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
Friends, There is a war being waged in Washington D.C. It is not a war between conservatives and liberals or Republicans and Democrats. Rather, it is one between elites in the U.S. government and the citizens they are supposed to represent. After decades on the ascent, **far-left radicals have fully seized control** over America’s institutions and government agencies and turned them against their enemies: the hardworking families, taxpayers, and patriots who love their country and desire to live in freedom. This woke war animates nearly every decision made by the loyal progressive partisans embedded within the federal bureaucracy. The examples are nearly too numerous to count and wholly destructive to our constitutional system. They include:
* The CDC colluding with teachers’ unions to shut down in-person schooling and inflict decades of learning loss for America’s children;
* The IRS is hiring 87,000 new auditors to comb through your family's tax records, looking for any excuse to charge you with fraud, especially if you hold political views that threaten their hold on power;
* The FBI targeting parents as domestic terrorists for daring to speak out at school board meetings;
* OSHA issuing vaccine mandates on frontline healthcare workers, first responders, and small business owners;
* The Department of Education awarding taxpayer-funded grants to promote Marxist-derived critical race theory in school systems;
* The EPA cracking down on reliable and sustainable sources of energy regardless of the financial pain it causes working-class households; and
* The Mayorkas-led DHS refusing to secure the border to stop the flow of deadly fentanyl and crime into America’s vulnerable communities.

The federal bureaucracy is engaged in **total war** against the liberty, security, and well-being of the American people. Simply put, **Washington has been weaponized.**

What these radicals and far-left elites fail to understand, however, is that the freedom-loving opposition is not just organizing, but advancing.**Conservative fighters** in the states are mobilizing to disarm and defeat the weaponized D.C. cabal.

Yes, we must continue the fight in Washington with the help of the House Freedom Caucus, which is leading the charge to dismantle the tyranny within the federal government. But more must be done at the **_state level_**.

And here is why...

The **State Freedom Caucus Network** was founded last year to create freedom caucuses in the 50 state capitols - modeled after the successful House Freedom Caucus. The Network is equipping liberty-minded state lawmakers with the resources, knowledge, and procedural strategies they need to ensure the rights of their citizens are protected and the progressive policies targeting American households are defeated.

In less than a year, the Network has launched seven official freedom caucuses in legislatures across the nation–including Georgia, South Carolina, Illinois, Arizona, Nevada, South Dakota, and Mississippi. Three more state freedom caucuses are on the way before the year’s end.

The impact of the Network is already being felt.

When the CDC voted last week to include COVID-19 vaccinations to the recommended vaccination list for children, members of the [Georgia](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=cfaf5beb66&e=64ecec6d03), [Nevada](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=b260524db2&e=64ecec6d03), [Arizona](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=792b3faee4&e=64ecec6d03), and [South Carolina](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=2168302fb2&e=64ecec6d03) freedom caucuses issued immediate and firm commitments to stop this attempted infringement at all costs. In Mississippi, Georgia, and Arizona, conservative lawmakers had the foresight to pass legislation prohibiting such mandates on school children long before the CDC’s declaration came to fruition, thus ensuring that Washington’s weaponization never had the chance to succeed in those states. Conservative lawmakers in Arizona, South Carolina, and Mississippi were at the tip of the spear to protect both employees and businesses from the Biden administration’s unconstitutional OSHA mandate on employers, passing legislation ensuring their citizens' conscience and religious liberty rights remained intact to exempt themselves from Washington’s tyrannical overreach. Indeed, if only every **state had organized freedom fighters** in the state legislature to defend their constituents from the radical left’s weaponized Washington bureaucracy, America would be able to turn the tide against D.C.’s tyranny against the American people. Fortunately, it is precisely for this mission and this moment that the **State Freedom Caucus Network** exists.

It is also for this reason that **we need your help**. While the Network has seen incredible success in less than a year, there is simply far more work that must be done to protect our friends, our neighbors, and our families from a weaponized Washington.

**Will you consider helping our efforts and fighting alongside us to equip and mobilize state legislatures to stand up to a weaponized Washington?

For just $10 a month, you can support the State Freedom Caucus Network as it works to secure liberty at the state level and stop Washington’s woke agenda in its tracks.

Click [here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=5aae6512c1&e=64ecec6d03) to set up your recurring monthly donation now. Even $25 or $50 will make a huge difference.**

Thanks to your help and your commitment to stopping the radical left’s war on the American people, we believe we will organize champion legislators in every state capitol to hold the line against the woke insanity emanating from Washington.
Keep fighting,
Andy Roth President, State Freedom Caucus Network P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation’s state capitols and in your home state. Please consider a [contribution here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=5a14a364a0&e=64ecec6d03) and join us as together we work to advance the cause of liberty.

Folks, I need you to vote.
I cannot believe we’re entering our last weekend before Election Day. We are **SO CLOSE TO WINNING** this race. Now is not the time to slow down, it’s time for full steam ahead.
The only way to ensure a #FreeFlorida is to **VOTE.** I need everyone to make sure that you, your friends, and your family have a **plan to vote.**
## _**[Make Your Plan to Vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54073566/377334536/-1612268846?refcode=20221104.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTcyNDc2Ny05NDVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eE0qpjlUzNDCPAzT6NDvynIZizUV9iuUKQvfAMmZFvY=&emci=455d4c56-5e5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=c9724767-945c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)**_
Whether you vote early or on Election Day, a few reminders when voting in person:
* You must be registered to vote in the county where you live. If you are already registered, you can vote at **any** early voting location **in the county you are registered in.**
* If you’re a registered Florida voter who has recently moved to a new county, be sure to **update your registered address** by contacting your county supervisor of elections or asking for help at your polling location when you go to vote.
* You need to bring a **photo ID** and a **signature ID** when you go to vote. This can be an ID that has both, such as a Florida driver’s license, or a credit card with a signature and a student ID with your picture on it.
* If you experience any problems with early voting, please call the Voter Assistance Hotline at **1-833-VOTE-FLA (1-833-868-3352).**

We’re fighting for our **rights,** for the future of our **democracy** and for the kind of world we want to leave for future generations. We’re going to give Ron DeSantis the fight of his life. And we’re going to win. Together.
– Charlie Crist

---

| | | **November 8th is Almost Here**
A very special thank you to all that called, emailed, texted, door-knocked, sign waved and donated. Without you there wouldn't be a campaign.
King 5 did a story on our race here in WA's 10th Congressional District. You may [read and watch the story here.](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=5e1b6678b3&e=d32193ab14) I also sat down for a longer interview with a local radio station. subject: I need your help in this final home stretch
body:
We only have four days until Election Day, Derek.
| | |
---
**We only have four days until Election Day, Derek.**
That's why our team has been working around the clock, knocking on doors, talking to voters, and spreading our message of progress. | | | Hi there Peter,

Election day is just 4 days away and there is still A LOT of work to be done.

Peter, I began this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had ever seen before.
**Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With determination.**
But I didn’t get the job in 2018.
But I didn’t quit, I kept working for Georgians. I changed my how but never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the pain of hope.
**But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the incredible story we can write for ourselves and our families – if we have a governor who sees all of us.**

_The following letter appeared in the_ Atlanta Journal-Constitution _on November 2, 2022:_

In response to Greg Bluestein and Patricia Murphy’s recent article “Abortion, crime and voting: A final Abrams-Kemp debate clash,” (Oct. 31), I urge Georgia voters to support Stacey Abrams as the Peach State’s next governor.

We need to elect leaders who know firsthand the real-life impact of the policies they’re backing, and know what it takes to get things done.

That’s why I’m urging you to support Stacey Abrams — a former city attorney, entrepreneur and legislator — in her gubernatorial bid.

Abrams, a pro-choice Democrat with significant leadership experience — in the private, public, and nonprofit sectors — will help Georgia thrive as governor.

Conversely, Brian Kemp is more concerned with using taxpayer dollars to enrich himself and his rich friends than helping working families that are struggling to make ends meet.

The choice is clear: Vote Stacey Abrams for governor on November 8.

_Brett Broesder, founding executive director, Democrats Serve, Milford, Conn._

body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
We’re 4 days away from Election Day. 4 days away from the moment voters in Michigan go to the ballot box to decide the future of our democracy.
Yes, friend. The stakes really are that high. Check out my message below and pitch it to the campaign to support us down this final stretch. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110422]
-Jocelyn
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jocelyn Benson
Date: Tuesday, November, 2022 at 2:26 PM
Subject: Here's my plan for the last week of the campaign
To: Our friend
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110422 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110422] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Friend,
This is it. The final week before Election Day. Together, we’ve been on an incredible journey and I want to take a moment to thank you for supporting this campaign.
Whether you made a grassroots donation, stuck a yard sign in front of your house, attended a rally, or just had a conversation with someone you know about the importance of protecting our elections, you have played a critical role in our pro-democracy movement.
I also hope that you’ve cast your absentee ballot or have a plan to vote on Election Day. If you have any questions about your voting plan, you can visit Michigan.gov/Vote. [Michigan.gov/Vote] There you’ll find a comprehensive resource tool kit that will ensure you’re able to cast a ballot on or before November 8th.
Now, we’ve got one week until Election Day, and there’s still a lot more work to do to ensure that democracy wins at the ballot box.
Here’s my plan. Since 2020, we’ve ensured that our elections remain accessible, secure, and transparent for every Michigan voter. Over these next seven days, I’ll be working with my fellow election officials to guarantee that every vote is counted in our state and that our election system continues to reflect the will of the people.
I’m also going to continue to hit the campaign trail to spread our message across the state! It’s been inspiring to meet so many supporters in person, and if these rallies are any indication, I know a powerful pro-democracy coalition is going to turn out next Tuesday.
In case you’re wondering, here’s what you can do to help. I know you’ve already voted or made a plan to vote by Election Day. Now, you need to make sure that every one of your family members, friends, and neighbors is participating in this historic election, too! Our democracy is only as strong as the people who support it, so let’s work together to make sure we turn out the biggest possible coalition of voters on November 8th.
Of course, it’s impossible to personally talk to every voter in our state. That’s why our campaign is continuing to run ads on TV and spreading our call to get out the vote. I’d appreciate it if you could pitch-in to help this effort, as every dollar helps magnify our message and turn out the support we need on Election Day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110422]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110422 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=110422]Thanks again, friend. Now let’s go win this.
Onward,
-Jocelyn

I also hope that you’ve cast your absentee ballot or have a plan to vote on Election Day. If you have any questions about your voting plan, you can visit Michigan.gov/Vote. [Michigan.gov/Vote] There you’ll find a comprehensive resource tool kit that will ensure you’re able to cast a ballot on or before November 8th. Now, we’ve got one week until Election Day, and there’s still a lot more work to do to ensure that democracy wins at the ballot box. Here’s my plan. Since 2020, we’ve ensured that our elections remain accessible, secure, and transparent for every Michigan voter. Over these next seven days, I’ll be working with my fellow election officials to guarantee that every vote is counted in our state and that our election system continues to reflect the will of the people. I’m also going to continue to hit the campaign trail to spread our message across the state! It’s been inspiring to meet so many supporters in person, and if these rallies are any indication, I know a powerful pro-democracy coalition is going to turn out next Tuesday. In case you’re wondering, here’s what you can do to help. I know you’ve already voted or made a plan to vote by Election Day. Now, you need to make sure that every one of your family members, friends, and neighbors is participating in this historic election, too! Our democracy is only as strong as the people who support it, so let’s work together to make sure we turn out the biggest possible coalition of voters on November 8th. Of course, it’s impossible to personally talk to every voter in our state. That’s why our campaign is continuing to run ads on TV and spreading our call to get out the vote. I’d appreciate it if you could pitch-in to help this effort, as every dollar helps magnify our message and turn out the support we need on Election Day. [] [ again, friend. Now let’s go win this. Onward, -Jocelyn [] This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Wanted to let you know that we just left a budget meeting, and I decided to go for it. After taking a look at the data and our fundraising, we think we have a clear opportunity to stay aggressive and invest just a little bit more into our turnout operation on the final weekend of early vote.

Looking at our plan this morning, we saw an opportunity to expand our organizing operation in these final days — knock on more doors, distribute more literature, and get more Cheri voters to the polls.

Peter,I am so deeply grateful to every Texan and American who supported, donated, volunteered, and early voted in support of our campaign.With four days until the final day of voting, I have never been more confident in our victory.The foundational principles our country was built upon have withstood the test of time, and going forward,**our great nation will be what we make of it.**

**I am asking for your vote** to build a more unified United States of America.
**I am asking for your support** to help voters know they have a candidate who will work for the people of Texas and bring solutions to Washington DC. I will be the candidate who goes to Washington DC and SECURES OUR SOUTHERN BORDER!
| [HELP SECURE THE SOUTHERN BORDER!](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=80346d1b1a&e=fdefed58de)
---

With less than 96 hours to go, [**we need your help financing our Get Out The Vote effort!**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=496c60b65c&e=fdefed58de) Help us make those final voter contacts to get me across the finish line:

Peter,

**Have I asked for too much?** I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, **with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling.**

Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. **Just 10 of you reading this contributed.** When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out.

**According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just 12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans.**

While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. **[[Help fund our field program]](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3f4f02a1dbb0490b98c664746d78d7cb&_e=rbfDbXH5bwqw9C9Dob3pcgOP4MNvKkB6aO7-WeeVyfc0bblWB6aK53sd2Mi8gaiIuIndfCimNVIzsm0SUnnVbSpYTtlGDMIbOX3LKfnxyzy6iW7pvUSbstbnVpIehUhqi0kwN1t2TMKaeF6RzLjLCeAwIyCv3zKFlQQE0gYs_PfIi6fX0vcfhYBib4__6Pkn3ZjpMGAIq2VHkU2PF5aEn78Jok3YqHhkOLD2XNuE1va6uibnWqrkvA1llebqxwSCLWK9MV8UCuzt4gz_6WlENbvnxtYcGJWj9EYBEakk8zXK7F1huu3dM_JYo6gz5vhCIZS2YC21rWnLtyFcXuwfTLlvbXu9PziGCMEgaGCoIFkC8dwScDrhzwTPYMraFSmtzDl41n4hNWG0LnW6JQ2XGQ%3D%3D)**

What does that mean? Well, **it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday.** We had set aside $6,000 for this program, but in the end had to move that money to fund our TV ADS when we fell well short of finding enough money to pay for both initiatives.

I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling. Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. Just 10 of you reading this contributed. When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out. According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just 12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans. While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. [[Help fund our field program]]() What does that mean? Well, it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday. NC-01 is one of the most critical races in the country, and Cook Political Report just upgraded its rating to _"Likely Democrat."_ Poll after poll shows that momentum is on Don’s side. But we cannot take anything for granted.

subject: The Small Business Choice For Governor
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DEREK SCHMIDT FOR KANSAS, INC
body:
Today, about 20,000 fewer Kansans are employed than four years ago. Derek Schmidt is working to change that. Derek believes Kansas needs to prioritize entrepreneurship, support existing businesses, develop and expand our workforce, build a climate of opportunity that encourages investment, identify and pursue specific investment opportunities as they arise, and partner with local leaders in support of their economic development priorities.| | |
---
| | Friend,**

** Today, about 20,000 fewer Kansans are employed than four years ago. Derek Schmidt is working to change that. Derek believes Kansas needs to prioritize entrepreneurship, support existing businesses, develop and expand our workforce, build a climate of opportunity that encourages investment, identify and pursue specific investment opportunities as they arise, and partner with local leaders in support of their economic development priorities. He believes that there is dignity in work and that able-bodied adults who can work, should work in order to qualify for welfare benefits or other public assistance. It’s common sense. Kansas is one of the worst-performing states in recovering the more than 157,000 jobs destroyed during Governor Kelly’s COVID-19 lockdowns. Kansas must never repeat her disastrous decision to deem certain jobs “essential” and others “non-essential.” **Every job and every paycheck is essential.** **Derek Schmidt is the pro-business choice for governor, that’s why he has received several key endorsements such as:**
---
---
**National Federation of Independent Business Kansas PAC \- **_“Derek has demonstrated a deep commitment to protecting small businesses from burdensome taxes and overreaching regulations. During his time in the Kansas Senate and as Attorney General, he has shown us he understands the challenges facing Kansas’s small businesses and will do everything he can to create an environment where they can continue to grow and create jobs.” -_**Dan Murray, NFIB State Director**
---
---
**Kansas Chamber of Commerce -**_“It is important that Kansans have elected leaders who support an environment that doesn’t hinder our businesses from competing across the country and around the world. Derek Schmidt understands the fundamental role business plays in the economic health of our state. He is the best choice for Kansas, its citizens, and its businesses.” -_**Alan Cobb, Kansas Chamber President and CEO**
---
---
**Associated Builders and Contractors - “** _Kansas deserves a leader who is interested in equal opportunity for the entire construction industry, including the 91 percent of Kansas construction companies who choose not to join a labor union. We know Schmidt will work tirelessly to enact sound policy initiatives that support free and open competition and workforce development opportunities for all Kansans.”_**-Ben Stallings, ABC Heart of America Board Chair**
---
---
**Wichita Area Builders Association (WABA) -**_“We look forward to working with you and your administration - post election.”_**\- Wess Galyon, President/CEO of WABA**
---
---
**Kansas Restaurant & Hospitality Association (KRHA) - **_“Derek shares the values a governor needs to help our smallest businesses have a fighting chance to succeed in Kansas. Our Association is acutely aware of the burden higher taxes will place on our member businesses, Kansas families and our member businesses cannot afford that. For these reasons we are proud to endorse the candidate we trust who will help our industry in the face of rapid inflation.”_**-Adam Mills, President of KRHA** Friend, supporting small businesses are the backbone of our economy. Laura Kelly’s failures have hurt Kansas families and it’s time for a change this November. ---

Fellow American,

_**The Day After Democrats Lose**_ By Bobby Jindal
---
The day after Election Day, once it's clear Democrats have lost seats in Congress, much of the media will undoubtedly lecture Republicans about the importance of embracing bipartisanship and moderation. It will advise Republicans to ignore the two years of Democratic overreach that fueled voters' frustration and that won the GOP so many races. It will also hector Democrats for not selling their policies aggressively enough—advice that would be dangerous for Democrats to heed. Republicans would do well to ignore advice from those who never before cared for their welfare, and instead advocate conservative policies as the course correction demanded by voters. Those eager to blame voters' ingratitude for the Democratic Party's dismal election performance ignore polling showing Democrats' approval numbers do not improve with more time spent talking about their accomplishments. Elections are about addressing challenges that lie ahead—Democrats only weaken themselves by trying to sell policy solutions that don't match the problems voters care about. Barack Obama was elected president to confront the housing crisis and resulting economic carnage, and instead spent his political capital on an unprecedented government intrusion into health care. Joe Biden was elected to contain the COVID-19 crisis and resulting economic damage, and instead spent his capital on record government spending to subsidize favored green energy purchases. **[FINISH READING ON NEWSWEEK.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=035a05bf65c14f988d865241fd10d6b6&_e=BpvqjC1j5fUp83V3WM1J0CnbefJWQAPkVRHEFMiQtQUtg-W2jxc0oqnvARfUizCHfVRxvjLx0S8W8laqpvEgVmdvyO9sIUTFvZlMYkCS2wwNTy-8U4V6YpxNLuRspKhqEB81VxjQzVnMxIWMrNsJKfMJbClUFE1oDlOr5T9PqNNWzrgcgUxiSIP9GLxAqLPB0vzCQSzXgTU4KnQVLPvBW98c4NGwT5uhiebR5icyOXDoIEmmuIJ46Xg5yDzhcqKf)**

Before I explain why, I have to ask you to invest in this campaign for the first time. I don’t enjoy asking for money, but we only have four days left in this election and every dollar counts. = I wake up every day determined to help the people of Pennsylvania — throughout my career, I’ve defended our freedom to choose, our right to vote, our right to clean water and air, and our ability to provide for our families. Here's how: I exposed the Catholic Church’s decades-long cover-up of child sexual abuse, identifying 301 predator priests and thousands of victims. I forced an agreement between two of the Commonwealth’s largest insurance companies — protecting health care access for almost 2 million Pennsylvanians. I’ve repeatedly gone to court to defend Pennsylvanians’ reproductive rights and a woman’s right to choose. During the 2020 presidential election, I protected the right to vote and defended Pennsylvania’s election results, winning in court dozens of times before and after Election Day. To this day, I’m still calling out the dangerous lies that undermine our democracy — especially the conspiracy theories coming from Doug Mastriano — and fighting to protect our voting rights in Pennsylvania. I’ve worked to make our streets safer by arresting more than 8,200 drug dealers and taking thousands of illegal guns off the streets. I’ve delivered hundreds of millions of dollars in relief for Pennsylvanian students, seniors, and workers who have been ripped off by greedy corporations. I have a track record of taking on the big fights and being a leader Pennsylvanians can count on. Now, I’m taking on the biggest fight yet: Winning this competitive Governor’s race, beating dangerous extremist Doug Mastriano, and defending all of our freedoms. But to win, I need your help. Insider News from the Political Revolution!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Midterms: Fight to the Finish | 1 MILLION CALLS & Counting | Oz
Pulls Ahead of Fetterman | How to Flip Voters & Senate Seats | 10 New
House Progressives? | Ellison vs Hedge Fund Lawyer | Green vs Developers |
Corporate Watchdogs in AZ | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1011&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1012&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

IT’S CRUNCH TIME! Tuesday is Election Day, and with razor-thin margins in
critical races — it all comes down to what we do right now. If you’re not
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7981?t=1013&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]knocking doors this weekend, get online and [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1014&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]make calls with us!!

We’re at a crossroads between a MAGA takeover and holding onto majorities
in Congress so we can keep fighting to deliver for working people and save
democracy.

We must defeat the far right, but we also have a chance to flip two Senate
seats, elect as many as 10 new allies to the US House, and build out our
bench of progressive power in down-ballot seats across the country.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1015&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

Some of our top races are extremely close, but our work can be the margin
of victory for powerful progressive allies like John Fetterman, Mandela
Barnes, and Keith Ellison.

The stakes couldn’t be higher, and there’s a real danger that many
progressive, independent, and working-class voters will not be motivated
to turn out.

That’s why Our Revolution is working overtime to make millions of voter
contacts through calls, texts, email, social media, and more as part of
our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1016&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]massive targeted GOTV operation.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1017&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

On Wednesday, Our Revolution Phonebank Force surpassed our goal of ONE
MILLION CALLS in the midterms!

“You really can flip a voter, I’ve done it!” said phone banker David on
Wednesday. “In just one night, I got 26 people to commit to voting for Our
Revolution candidates.”

THANK YOU to David and all of our callers who are making a difference in
critical races across the country!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1018&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]With the polls this tight, every call and every voter we flip helps tip
the balance. Sign up for a phone bank shift today!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1019&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

ORGANIZER SPOTLIGHT: We want to give a special shout-out to Diane Morgan
who has done amazing work leading the Our Revolution Phonebank Force.

“There’s more than one thing on the ballot — reproductive justice,
criminal justice, economic justice — every call people make pushes the
needle toward justice,” Diane told our call team as we celebrated
surpassing our 1 Million Call Goal Wednesday night.

Not only does she provide great support for our volunteers, but Diane is
also an incredible organizer and activist who helps lead Our Revolution
Ohio and ran our GOTV for Nina Turner! Thank you, Diane!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1020&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]LAST CHANCE TO MAKE CALLS!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1021&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

“If we have any chance to create an economy that works for all of us, not
just the 1 percent,” Bernie wrote in [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7790?t=1022&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]The Hill, “we must expand the
Democratic majority in Congress and push them to represent the needs of
the working class, not the billionaire class.”

Under this administration, Bernie and our movement worked hard to get the
first steps on climate, student debt, tax fairness, drug price
negotiation, and other priorities — but we’re just getting started and
have much more work to do.

“Democrats can’t just run on fear,” Our Revolution Executive Director
Joseph Geevarghese told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7797?t=1023&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]ABC News. “You’ve got to make the case for
what we can accomplish if people come out to vote.”

If we pull off key wins on Tuesday, it could put us within striking
distance of the filibuster for a renewed push on top priorities like
voting rights, reproductive rights, and the PRO Act.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1024&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

“If Democrats win, it’ll be in no small part because of the overturning of
Roe v Wade,” Joseph told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7982?t=1025&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]The Independent. “And, if they win on that,
they’ve got to deliver on that.”

Democratic majorities would also mean the chance to fight for agenda items
like housing, childcare, universal pre-K, paid leave, home healthcare, and
more.

Joseph urged Democratic leaders to “speed the priorities that would
deliver on things that will help them win” — like improving the standard
of living for working-class Americans and expanding labor rights.”

“We have to make the case that an expanded Senate majority will mean we
pass a higher minimum wage, lower drug costs, and more aggressive climate
protection,” he said.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1026&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]Chip in now to help fund the direct voter outreach that can be the
margin of victory in key swing states!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1027&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

That’s right — we could add as many as TEN new progressive House members
on Tuesday! “We’ll have a historic number of progressives, true
progressives, in Congress,” Our Revolution-endorsed Greg Casar told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7983?t=1028&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]In
These Times.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1029&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

Imagine what we could accomplish by electing: Delia Ramirez (IL-3),
Maxwell Frost (FL-10), Summer Lee (PA-12), Andrea Salinas (OR-6), Jasmine
Crockett (TX-30), Jonathan Jackson (IL-1), Becca Balint (VT), Greg Casar
(TX-35), Jamie McLeod-Skinner (OR-5), and Michelle Vallejo (TX-15).

Some of these are very competitive races, but winning these seats would
prevent a Republican majority and vastly grow the power of our progressive
voting bloc in the House.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1030&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]SEND MORE ALLIES TO CONGRESS!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1031&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

Exciting news — Our Revolution is joining Bernie Sanders on the campaign
trail in Pittsburgh and Philadelphia this weekend!

After stops in NV, WI, OR, CA, TX, and MI, we’re rounding out Bernie’s
GOTV Tour with major rallies and canvassing events in Pennsylvania.

Starting at 10 am Saturday, Bernie will launch a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7981?t=1032&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]canvass for Summer
Lee. We’ll knock on doors through the City of Pittsburgh, and make our way
to the [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7984?t=1033&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]rally on the Pitt campus at noon.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1034&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

At noon on Sunday, join us in Philadelphia for a fun day of [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7985?t=1035&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]knocking
on doors for Fetterman, then we’ll grab a bite to eat and head over to the
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7986?t=1036&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]Bernie Philly rally at 5:30 pm.

The rallies will feature live music, free swag, celebrity appearances, and
great speakers — you don’t want to miss this!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1037&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

LET'S GO! Join us in our last MASSIVE phone bank push to flip Senate seats
in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.

Our Revolution phone banker Carol told us she spoke to one PA voter this
week who felt that “Democrats don’t have our back” and care more about
spending money on wars abroad than our economic needs here.

“I told her a vote for John Fetterman will send a progressive to the
Senate to stand with Bernie against the establishment — and she said
she’ll vote!” Carol was thrilled to report.

Another call team member, Diane, spoke to a Wisconsin woman who was just
sick and tired of politics and wasn’t going to vote.

“We connected as mothers and talked about what the rollback of abortion
rights means for our daughters,” Diane said. “I got her to commit to
voting for Mandela Barnes because he’ll fight for her child and mine.”

This is the kind of difference you can make by joining a phone bank shift
with Our Revolution. Help us make another 100,000 calls for [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7126?t=1038&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]John
Fetterman and [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7688?t=1039&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]Mandela Barnes in this final weekend!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1040&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

Despite a massive right-wing misinformation campaign, grassroots
organizing and direct voter outreach have kept it within reach for us to
flip two Senate seats in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.

But, Dr. Oz has pulled ahead of John Fetterman and Ron Johnson has an edge
over Mandela Barnes, which means [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1041&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]we must leave it all on the field
over the next few days to turn out every voter possible in these key swing
states!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1042&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

We know that if we connect with each voter 4 times — by phone, text, mail,
social media, ads, and groundwork — we can boost turnout by 11 percent.
This could be the decisive factor in races across the country, but we
can’t do it without you!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1043&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]FUND OUR EMERGENCY GOTV WORK

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1044&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

Minnesota AG Keith Ellison is in a fight for re-election against hedge
fund lawyer Jim Schultz, who wants to ban abortion and let corporate
criminals off the hook.

Keith helped lead the team that convicted Derek Chauvin for the murder of
George Floyd — and now the far right is coming after him for it.

While Keith fights price gougers, Schultz’s hedge fund employer made
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7792?t=1045&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]$2.6B as a pandemic profiteer. While Schultz wants to gut consumer
protections, Keith has won more than $300M for Minnesotans by holding Big
Pharma accountable for the opioid crisis.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1046&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

Phonebanker Amanda told us of a conversation she had this week with a GOP
voter in Minnesota who was on the fence.

“We talked about how Keith is the People’s Lawyer and taking on Big Ag and
Big Pharma,” Amanda said. “The voter agreed we need bust-up corporate
monopolies, and Keith’s track record earned her vote!”

This is a priority race, and we need all hands on deck! Will you join
Amanda to make calls in these last few days of the campaign?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7681?t=1047&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7980?t=1048&akid=3693%2E5885482%2EvxKIX2 ][IMG]

We are proud to support Megan Green — a former Bernie delegate — in her
grassroots campaign for President of the St. Louis Board of Alderman.

On the board, Megan helped pass a $15 min wage while her opponent Jack
Coatar voted against it. She supports hotel workers in their union
efforts, while Coatar takes money from their anti-union bosses.

“We have to put an end to the corruption that has had a stranglehold on

| | GWINN, Mich. — In today's divisive political climate, where outlandish quips from extremists dominate airwaves, it's rare to find a candidate making waves by their willingness to engage with 'the other side.' Dr. Bob Lorinser (D, MI1) is more than willing; he regularly seeks opportunities to find common ground. Many consider Lorinser one of the most respected physicians in Michigan. He received the distinction of 'Michigan Family Medicine Educator of the Year' in 2003. [Lorinser's résumé](https://www.votedrbob.com/so/4eOH4Tsfr/c?w=JZIVAaV1ojo2qchbIIBua9IoV5AtU9Rq5ererclSWDY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudm90ZWRyYm9iLmNvbS9hbGxhYm91dGJvYiIsInIiOiI3ZTljNmM1My1jZmE5LTQ5ZTEtYjc3Yi04ZjNlMDNiMzI5NDEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIxODY2MjZkNS1jYTVlLTQ2MzMtODM0YS1lODgzZDBiZGRkNzUifQ) is racked with leadership credentials, including five tours overseas as a State Department diplomat. But, the locals endearingly just call their health department medical director 'Doc' or 'Dr. Bob.' "I don't give a damn what ticket Doc's running under," said small business owner Brian Harsch of Jean Kay's Pasties. "I usually vote conservative, but the last few years have been leaning independent. Doc over Bergman? No question, I'm voting for Dr. Bob because I trust him."
---
| |
---
| | Brian Harsch, Owner - Jean Kay's Pasties Former Representative Bart Stupak, a Democrat, served the district for 18 years until 2011. Since then, Lorinser says, 'Yoopers' and Northern Michiganders haven't changed much.
"There are voters in my district who believe mainstream, establishment politicians are no longer representative of their values," [said Dr. Lorinser.](https://www.votedrbob.com/so/4eOH4Tsfr/c?w=hWjb2G3O8R_kZz7GKpBOBk2Oz_97UKgC4WXzuJZq6eA.) "Which means it's my party's duty to reignite our understanding of rural America." Dr. Bob is earning voters' trust. He says he rarely receives criticism about his positions on issues. Currently, constituents' primary concerns are inflation, gas and food prices, and the rising cost of rent. "Many believe the Democratic Party is responsible," says Dr. Bob. "But, both parties have their faults, and hardworking rural families often face the brunt of these economic burdens. My goal is to listen and put forward real solutions that will solve these problems, not convince voters the problems don't exist."
Alternatively, Lorinser's opponent, incumbent Rep. Jack Bergman (R, MI1), is solely focused on blaming the party in power. Lorinser says it's disingenuous and solutionless. "My opponent wants to play the blame game, but he offers no meaningful solutions," Lorinser claims. "It's unacceptable. Combating inflation and advocating for economic growth requires leadership and compromise from both sides. The American people deserve better than for us to make this a partisan problem."
Skeptics often ask Dr. Bob how frequently he'll vote in lockstep with his party or how he'll practice independence when elected. Will he be another stooge to Speaker Pelosi, President Biden, Gov. Whitmer, or Sen. Schumer?."I never thought my vote was for or against a party. My vote will be my best assessment for America, my district, and its people," says Lorinser. Dr. Bob may be a rookie candidate, but he's not a novice to politics, leadership, or solving problems. "Being a political outsider is actually a huge advantage," says Lorinser.
"It's refreshing," said Harsch.

body:
A new Death Star
| | | | |

| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3eb5c52d-3e04-4e4c-839c-0e2a6d576e53/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | **Cliff’s Note:** **Per _CBS News_ polling, "If November’s election sees a big turnout of young voters and voters of color...the Battleground Tracker predicts Democrats hold onto the majority by a single seat..." If not, we lose 10-15 seats, and the House, where Marjorie Taylor Greene will promptly push for Joe Biden's impeachment. _We can't let this happen_. Like the Kansas abortion referendum, younger voters will determine if it does. Please keep this in mind as you read Mark Hamill's urgent plea below to support _Voters of Tomorrow_ , as they register every last voter in states like Colorado--where Lauren Boebert's in danger of losing her seat--that allow voter registration through Election Day. ** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T60a6c571-5d54-4ffd-8e7b-2aa6ab72896f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dear Peter, **Voters of Tomorrow, has a simple plan: Educate, register, and mobilize young voters so they can have a voice in the next election. Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18%, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only 4 days away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through election day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. Can you rush a donation right now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf8cc80b7-2d8e-4c51-95e3-55b9dacbee4c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **A $22 donation = FIVE new voters registered! $44 and they can register TEN NEW VOTERS! Affordability is on the Ballot Time for change!
**Eversource announced today that customers could see a 40% increase in electricity costs and a 20% increase in natural gas prices come January. **This is on the heels of large increases in home heating oil prices, warnings of diesel fuel shortages, prospects of rolling blackouts here in the Northeast and rising interest rates making life even more unaffordable for many Connecticut residents and businesses.
Some of our residents are falling behind on paying their bills. **With the holidays and winter coming, families, seniors and those on fixed incomes are already making tough decisions to heat their homes or put food on the table. **
CT ranks **50****th****** in getting Federal Funding coming back to our state and my opponent has voted for every reckless spending bill, including the misnamed “Inflation Reduction Act”, which has poured fuel on the inflation fire (pun intended). Why? Because he is beholden to his party’s leadership rather than the people he is supposed to serve here in southwest Connecticut! **It’s time to expect better!** As your next congresswoman, I will bring my experience of working collaboratively with state and local leaders of all parties to Washington and will ensure that Connecticut residents and businesses are no longer forgotten.

Eversource announced today that customers could see a 40% increase in electricity costs and a 20% increase in natural gas prices come January. This is on the heels of large increases in home heating oil prices, warnings of diesel fuel shortages, prospects of rolling blackouts here in the Northeast and rising interest rates making life even more unaffordable for many Connecticut residents and businesses. Some of our residents are falling behind on paying their bills. With the holidays and winter coming, families, seniors and those on fixed incomes are already making tough decisions to heat their homes or put food on the table. CT ranks 50th** in getting Federal Funding coming back to our state and my opponent has voted for every reckless spending bill, including the misnamed “Inflation Reduction Act”, which has poured fuel on the inflation fire (pun intended). Why? Because he is beholden to his party’s leadership rather than the people he is supposed to serve here in southwest Connecticut! It’s time to expect better! As your next congresswoman, I will bring my experience of working collaboratively with state and local leaders of all parties to Washington and will ensure that Connecticut residents and businesses are no longer forgotten. IT’S TIME for a champion to recognize the impacts on people. IT’S TIME for a champion who follows through on promises. IT’S TIME for a champion who shepherds projects to progress. IT’S TIME for a champion for Connecticut. We need you! Volunteers needed: POLL WORKERS AND PHONE BANKERS NEEDED! It ALL matters & we can’t do it without you! | Jayme Stevenson Candidate for Congress, District 4 Connecticut | ABOUT JAYME** I’m running for Congress to bring common sense and balance back to Washington and to give voice to the people of the 4th Congressional District who have been left behind by politicians working for themselves and a national party agenda. As a trusted leader and mother of five children, I understand the impacts government policies have on our communities and promise to fight for Connecticut children, families and businesses. | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | "Instagram" ---|---|--- Jayme Stevenson 1326 Post Road, Fairfield, 06824

This week, Elissa’s opponent touted the endorsements of three different extreme, right-wing figures, including election-denying congressional candidate Harriet Hageman, Putin stooge Tulsi Gabbard, and anti-choice warrior Mike Pence. | Dear Peter,I was intervened by Idaho Public Television in their studio, they told me because Brad Little would not join their debate they wanted to interview the governor candidates separately. I think you will find this interview one that you can _easily share with your friends_. Please take a look, and I hope you enjoy watching it. Just click anywhere... [](https://www.votebundy.com/media/interviews/?do=november-2nd-2022-idaho-public-tv-idaho-reports-ammon-bundy-independent-candidate-for-idaho-governor)
I think there's something important going on in this interview. No, I don't know why Public Radio leans so strongly to the left and is so liberal. It obviously is. You can see that during the interview, too. _But there's something very powerful going on as well, and I hope it encourages you thereby._ The logic of America, the logic of Idaho is truly compelling. Most liberals have never heard it. Take, for instance, my interviewer's very first question. "Why," she asks me, "do you want to be Governor?" As we sat and spoke, it was crystal clear to me that _the very idea of a person being completely compelled by the situation to run for an office he doesn't want was utterly surprising to her._ This happened repeatedly. But, here's the true key. _If we conservatives will simply show up and hold the line of our beliefs we are far, far more persuasive than any case the left ever brings to bear._ We've discussed before why Brad Little had to tuck tail and run for cowardly cover as opposed to debating me. Here you see the real reason why. **Our arguments simply compell agreement.** Not by force, or being forcefully stated, but by their complete and utter truth.As you consider the coming days to the election, please share this interview with as many Idahoans as you can. And please be confident, the truth of our case is how we're going to win.Sincerely Yours,Ammon BundyP.S. Don't forget to join the Virtual Q&A on Monday (7th) at 7PM MST. This will be the very last time that you can ask me questions before the election. It will be my last public event before the big day. Register here: <https://www.votebundy.com/campaign-events/virtual-townhall/>

# **Newsletter-November 4 Vol. 2, #37**
---
| | |
##
4 November 22

**3 Days Until Election Day!**

THIS IS STILL CRUNCH TIME!

Mail-In Ballots are out. Early voting is over. Election Day is in 3 days!
We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!

The Campaign is doing great!

**Radio Ads**
Radio Ads are running through election day on WIHT (Hot 99.5), WAVA (105.1) and WMAL (105.9).
The [30 second generic ad](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=c90e133f83&e=12a37459a2) and the [60 sec faith-based ad](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=a80ea65f5d&e=12a37459a2) are attached. Please share the ads freely with the appropriate audiences.

**Sign Waving-Saturday - THIS IS OUR LAST SATURDAY TO CAMPAIGN!**
This Saturday, November 5
Noon-1p
The intersection of Greenbelt Road & Kenilworth Ave.
The closed Sandy Spring Bank
6329 Greenbelt Rd. (Rt 193), Greenbelt, 20770
FREE JW4C T-shirt provided for those who have not yet received one.
If you have a JW4C T-shirt, please wear it.
Be sure to bring your water bottle.

Jeff will be moving throughout the District on Saturday Sign Waving in vital precincts.
If you are unable to make Noon-1p Sign Waving, contact Jeff at 240-736-4487.
He needs your help and support.

**Signage**
More signs are going up in the key precincts. We need help to get more signs out...this includes yard signs.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.
Please contact us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

**Leave Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters**
The phone calling team is amazing! 44,502 voters have been contacted as of today! Way To Go Team!
Contact Val for the 15 minute training.
443-386-8303

**Final Donations** We are so grateful for the sacrificial support. As we near the end, please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us boost our radio ads and texting.
**Social Media**
Don't miss some of the amazing stories on social media @RepJeffWarner.

**Prayer and Fasting**
If you pray and/or fast, we are asking you to join us in asking God for His perfect will to be done. Please join us on Mondays or whenever works best for you.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 3 days, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=f15e45a9cb&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

I'm deeply concerned, friend – and I hope you'll give me just one minute to explain why:
Early voting in Georgia ends TODAY. It's one of the most consequential periods of the election, during which a huge number of voters cast their ballots in our race that could decide Senate control.

**It's why we set a goal to raise _$1,000,000_ to reach these voters before Herschel Walker does – but unfortunately, we're falling way short.**
We are putting resources into the field as fast as grassroots donations like yours come in, so I'm hopeful we can still turn out more early voters before tonight's crucial deadline.

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: BELIEVE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

With grateful hearts, my family and I thank you for your prayers and well wishes for Paul. As I mentioned during our weekly grassroots meeting - your work to strengthen our Democracy gives me strength. If you’d like to see the entire zoom, please visit my Twitter feed:

https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi/status/1588625289491673089?s=20&t=_YOUPj0oK9g9LCIaRvLXMg

As we approach November 8, I want to reach back to the earliest days of this Congress to affirm your commitment and support that make our work possible.

Every day of this term, Democrats in Congress have worked with President Biden to meet the urgent needs of the American People. Because of the Republicans’ obstruction, assaults on our freedoms and plans to undermine Social Security benefits, we have known from Day One that we must Hold the House to protect our Democracy. To do so, House Democrats have been preparing to meet this moment with Mobilization, Message and Money.

The urgency of the election and our readiness have attracted a magnificently diverse field of candidates who believe they will win. When the GOP saw the courage and caliber of our candidates, they poured in endless dark special interest money to suffocate the airwaves with their misrepresentations.

As I’ve often said, Democrats don’t have endless money — but we’ve got people — you, our Volunteers in Politics (VIPs) who make everything possible.

I so appreciate all of you who have been working endlessly to get out the vote. Thanks to you, many of the races are within the margin of error and too close to call, and will definitely be determined on the ground by GOTV.

My message today is BELIEVE – to believe that we can and will win and to act upon that belief by going all-out to get out the vote. We must shine a bright light on our values to respect the sanctity of the vote and the safety of voters and election workers. We must all know our power and show our power at the polls to defend our

Democracy, protect our planet and advance our values.

Thank you for all you have done and will do.

Onward to a great Democratic Victory!

Sincerely,
NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

People are sick and tired of the way things are going and want to have a brighter future.That's exactly what I will deliver! | |

---
| | | Hello,

Nationally we are seeing high turnout rates among young Democrats. Turnout for young Republicans is plummeting. They are sick and tired of the way things are going and want to have a brighter future.

**That's exactly what I will deliver! **

**I've demonstrated as a former Billings Councilmember and a Montanan that I have what it takes to lead this great state.** I have led real change in Montana and across this nation with a strong fight against human trafficking. I will fight for Montana farmers and ranchers, will fight for Montana families and fight for not just women's healthcare but lowering the cost of all healthcare.
---
|
---
| [I'm ready to invest in Montana's future, are you? ](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=8934eeef14&e=2f4ec52c5e)

| | | |
---

# Everyone Hates Matt Gaetz
---
| [DONATE](https://thepoliticalmatrix.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c3bea68b6a04118d41358241a&id=8e51803524&e=10b14e738f "DONATE")
